items.title: 〈台股風向球〉外資期貨做空未轉向前 題材股輪動維繫多方熱度
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Foreign Futures Short Positions Remain Unchanged, Thematic Stocks Rotate to Sustain Bullish Momentum
paras: 在台股連4周走跌合計重挫20%後，國安基金宣布進場，使本周加權指數強彈達3973點，收復5日線和10日線短期均線，漲幅達10%，下檔有撐的氣氛逐漸轉強，但又遭逢黃仁勳事件，令來回波動相當大，台股交易員提醒，外資期貨淨空單續增至已超過10萬口，隨著美股有壓，仍要注意短線有獲利者出場造成的壓力，若有行情先以個股或族群表現為主流。
上周加權指數反彈達10%，不過，外資仍賣超968億元與內資投信對作，呈現連7周賣超，主要賣超中鋼(2002-TW)和仁寶(2324-TW)均超過6萬張，力積電(6770-TW)和大成鋼(2027-TW)均逾4.6萬張，英業達(2356-TW)達3.2萬張，廣達(-TW)2.1萬張，元大台灣50正2(00631L-TW)近1.9萬張，台積電(2330-TW)和正新(2105-TW)均達1.7萬張。
反觀投信仍維持買超力道，本周主要集中在大型電子股和金控股，有助穩住大盤漲點，一周來買超中信金(2891-TW)近5.4萬張，南亞(1303-TW)4.2萬張，元大台灣50(0050-TW)近3萬張，國泰金(2882-TW)和富邦金(2881-TW)均逾2萬張，元大台灣50正2達1.6萬張，台積電近1.5萬張，台玻(1802-TW)1.2萬張，日月光投控(3711-TW)逾8000張。
台股交易員認為，九合一大選前的選前行情可望使大盤明顯具備下檔支撐，然而美股電子股因黃仁勳事件仍是餘波蕩漾，且大盤在過去一周大漲10%後面臨月線和季線的反壓，較好狀況是先量縮整理、多頭以題材股維持輪動熱度。
永豐投顧指出，加權指數處在月線、季線與半年線下方，月線與季線走勢向下正在形成壓力，均線排列仍未明朗，但是KD 指標上已交叉向上，在此位階很可能盤整；整體而言，短線反彈仍屬跌深後的修復階段，尚未重回多頭結構。
從籌碼面來看，外資 10 月賣超創下歷史單月新高，但在反彈過程卻未出現外資買超回補，從過往經驗來看，新波段的開始往往伴隨外資回補，因此需等外資轉買，加上新台幣止貶回升帶動更多海外資金回流台灣。
paras_en: After four consecutive weeks of declines that wiped out about 20% of the Taiwan index, the National Security Fund announced a buy-in, pushing the weighted index up sharply to 3,973 points this week, recapturing the 5‑day and 10‑day moving averages with a 10% gain. The lower‑level support gradually strengthened, but the market was hit by the Jensen Huang incident, causing large swings. Traders warned that foreign futures net short positions have risen to over 100,000 contracts; with pressure from the U.S. market, short‑term profit‑taking could add further pressure, so any rally may first be led by individual stocks or sector performances.

Last week the weighted index rebounded 10%, yet foreign investors still sold a net NT$96.8 billion, out‑selling domestic institutional investors for seven consecutive weeks. The biggest sells were China Steel (2002‑TW) and Compal (2324‑TW), each over 60,000 lots, followed by Largan Precision (6770‑TW) and Da‑Cheng Steel (2027‑TW) each above 46,000 lots, Inventec (2356‑TW) 32,000 lots, Quanta (‑TW) 21,000 lots, Yuanta Taiwan 50 Plus (00631L‑TW) nearly 19,000 lots, and both TSMC (2330‑TW) and Cheng Shin (2105‑TW) around 17,000 lots each.

Conversely, institutional investors kept net buying, focusing this week on large‑cap electronics and financial stocks, helping to anchor the market’s gains. Over the past week they bought net 54,000 lots of CTBC Financial Holding (2891‑TW), 42,000 lots of Nan Ya (1303‑TW), nearly 30,000 lots of Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), over 20,000 lots each of Cathay Financial (2882‑TW) and Fubon Financial (2881‑TW), 16,000 lots of Yuanta Taiwan 50 Plus, about 15,000 lots of TSMC, 12,000 lots of Taiwan Glass (1802‑TW), and more than 8,000 lots of ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW).

A Taiwan market trader believes that the pre‑election rally ahead of the “nine‑in‑one” election could give the index clear lower‑level support. However, U.S. tech stocks are still rattled by the Jensen Huang episode, and after the index’s 10% surge last week it now faces resistance from the monthly and quarterly moving averages. The best scenario is a contraction‑phase consolidation, with bulls keeping thematic‑stock rotation lively.

Yong‑Feng Investment Advisory notes that the weighted index sits below its monthly, quarterly and semi‑annual moving averages, with downward pressure forming on the monthly and quarterly trends. The moving‑average alignment is still unclear, but the KD indicator has already crossed upward, suggesting the market may linger in a sideways range at this level. Overall, the short‑term bounce is still a recovery phase after a deep decline and has not yet returned to a bullish structure.

From a chip‑flow perspective, foreign investors set a historic monthly net‑sell record in October, yet no net buying has appeared during the rebound. Historically, new upward waves often begin when foreign investors start to buy back, so a turn to net buying—combined with the New Taiwan dollar’s halt in depreciation and its subsequent appreciation—could attract more overseas capital back to Taiwan.

items.title: 特斯拉Cybercab開放個人訂購 售價3萬美元
items.title_en: Tesla Opens Personal Orders for Cybercab at $30,000
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 宣布向受邀客戶開放Cybercab訂購用於「個人用途」，售價約3萬美元，客戶需要支付1,000美元訂金，且必須訂閱每月299美元自動駕駛服務。
首批交付預定將於12月開始，但初期範圍僅限於美國德州5座城市以及指定區域。
特斯拉執行長馬斯克表示，隨著監管審批陸續通過，Cybercab將逐步向全美用戶開放。
不過，他也表示，每月299美元訂閱費用「太高了」，定價應與特斯拉其他車型上FSD及聯網服務費用相當，即每月約115美元。
馬斯克上周曾說，Cybercab未來還會實現一系列效率提升，使電池組容量能降至40kWh。特斯拉還會採用液態銀作為車身顏色，讓整體色彩不會過於單調。
馬斯克重申，Cybercab生產優先級高於Cybertruck。「如果我們必須維持Cybertruck複雜的產線和供應鏈，並為其持續投入工程技術人員，那麼這些人才、工廠和設備就無法用於擴大Cybercab產能。而Cybercab才是真正能夠徹底改變全球陸地交通運輸格局的車型。」
Cybercab作為特斯拉Robotaxi車隊未來主力，配備剪刀門（又稱蝴蝶門），車內沒方向盤、沒油門和剎車踏板，也沒後視鏡。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) announced that invited customers can now order the Cybercab for personal use at a price of about $30,000, with a $1,000 deposit required and a mandatory $299 per month autonomous driving subscription.
The first deliveries are slated to begin in December, initially limited to five cities in Texas and designated areas within the state.
CEO Elon Musk said that as regulatory approvals come through, the Cybercab will be gradually opened to users across the United States.

However, he also noted that the $299 monthly subscription fee is "too high" and should be priced similarly to Tesla's other models' Full Self‑Driving and connectivity services, roughly $115 per month.

Musk said last week that the Cybercab will eventually incorporate a series of efficiency improvements, reducing battery pack capacity to 40 kWh, and will use liquid silver as a body color to avoid a monotonous appearance.

Musk reiterated that Cybercab production takes priority over the Cybertruck, stating that if resources remain tied to the complex Cybertruck production line and its engineering staff, those people, factories, and equipment cannot be used to expand Cybercab capacity, and that Cybercab is the model that can truly transform global land transportation.

The Cybercab, envisioned as the future backbone of Tesla's robotaxi fleet, features scissor (butterfly) doors and an interior without a steering wheel, accelerator or brake pedals, and no rear‑view mirrors.

items.title: DeepSeek全面開放App API！搜尋、文件解析、語音功能全解鎖　開發者可複製官方App
items.title_en: DeepSeek Fully Opens App API! Search, Document Parsing, and Voice Features Unlocked – Developers Can Replicate Official App
paras: DeepSeek宣布全面開放旗下應用程式的多項核心功能API，將原本整合在官方App中的網路搜尋、深度思考搜尋、文件解析、連結閱讀及語音互動等能力提供給第三方開發者，讓企業與個人開發者能更容易打造功能完整的人工智慧（AI）應用，甚至複製出與DeepSeek官方App幾乎相同的使用體驗。
DeepSeek指出，開發者只需在既有API中啟用相應參數，就能使用這些擴充功能。官方也同步開發並開源一款輕量級聊天應用程式Demo，提供完整範例，甚至支援匯入DeepSeek既有的歷史對話紀錄。
這項更新讓開發者不必再自行串接多種第三方服務，就能在單一聊天介面中整合搜尋、文件閱讀與語音互動等功能，降低打造AI應用的技術門檻。

DeepSeek開放App核心功能　搜尋、文件解析整合API

對一般使用者而言，DeepSeek App已不只是單純的聊天工具。使用者提出問題後，系統能依需求搜尋網路、閱讀網頁、分析上傳文件，再整合相關資訊產生回答，背後涉及多種工具調用與資料處理流程。
但對第三方開發者來說，即使已經串接DeepSeek模型API，仍須自行尋找搜尋服務、開發文件解析工具、處理網頁內容擷取，並協調不同工具之間的資料傳遞。遇到複雜任務時，還得處理多次搜尋、資料閱讀及後續推理的順序與上下文整合。
這次DeepSeek將相關基礎工作整合至官方服務端。根據公告，目前V4.1-Flash模型（deepseek-flash）已在Messages、Responses及Chat Completions三類API介面中支援多項擴充功能。
其中，網路搜尋是此次開放的重點之一。開發者啟用deepseek_web_search工具後，模型在非思考模式下即可依照使用者問題，自動進行網頁或圖片搜尋，並在回答中附上引用來源。
若開啟深度思考模式，模型還能在多步推理過程中自行搜尋網路、閱讀相關連結，再根據取得的資訊繼續分析。
文件處理功能也納入此次更新。開發者可直接上傳PDF、Office文件及圖片，由DeepSeek官方服務進行純文字擷取或圖文混合解析，再將處理結果交由模型分析。
至於外部網頁閱讀，開發者只需啟用deepseek_read_url，模型便能自動辨識使用者訊息中的網址、擷取網頁內容，並結合對話脈絡回答問題。
DeepSeek也提供模型安全檢查參數，可針對輸入及輸出內容進行基礎風險審查，若觸及風險條件，系統便會回傳拒絕回答標記。官方提醒，對外提供應用服務的開發者應啟用安全檢查，並履行相關內容安全審查、大模型登記及AI標識等義務。
此外，Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR及TTS等功能也以獨立API形式開放，開發者可依需求單獨調用或自由組合。例如，學習應用可先透過OCR辨識考卷，再使用DeepSeek解說題目；語音助理則能利用ASR將使用者語音轉成文字，交由模型理解需求，最後透過TTS產生語音回答。

開源聊天Demo　支援匯入DeepSeek歷史對話

為展示新版API的實際應用，DeepSeek同步開發並開源一款輕量級聊天應用Demo。官方表示，透過新版API，開發者已能打造與DeepSeek官方App功能基本一致的產品，示範專案甚至支援直接匯入DeepSeek歷史對話。
不過，使用這些擴充功能仍須支付相關費用。依照DeepSeek公布的定價方案，開發者除了支付模型本身的Token費用，也須負擔工具調用費用。
換言之，雖然可以省下部分基礎工具的開發及維護工作，但實際成本仍會隨模型用量與工具調用次數增加。

DeepSeek：下一個超級App可能只屬於一個人

DeepSeek此次開放API，也讓第三方開發者更容易將官方產品的能力整合至自有應用。對DeepSeek而言，這代表旗下模型與工具服務有機會進入更多官方App以外的使用場景。
DeepSeek Harness負責人崔添翼在社群平台X發文表示，DeepSeek產品背後的各項核心能力如今都已透過API開放，希望隨著開發門檻降低，開發者社群能創造更多元、更完善且更具想像力的產品。
他也提出對未來應用程式發展的看法，認為下一個超級App不一定要服務所有人，每個人都可能有能力打造專屬於自己的超級App。
過去科技業追求的超級App，通常以龐大用戶規模、豐富功能及多元使用場景為目標。但隨著AI程式開發與代理技術發展，軟體開發成本逐漸降低，開發者也不必再從頭建立每一項基礎功能。
使用者未來或許能依照自己的工作與生活習慣，打造高度個人化的AI應用。這類產品不一定需要大量使用者，也未必以商業化為目標，而是針對特定需求提供更貼近個人使用情境的服務。
從過去由少數網路公司打造一款App服務大量使用者，到未來更多人能依照自身需求開發專屬工具，DeepSeek此次全面開放應用API，正是降低這類開發門檻的一步。
paras_en: DeepSeek announced that it is fully opening multiple core function APIs of its application, providing third‑party developers with capabilities that were previously integrated only in the official app—web search, deep‑thought search, document parsing, link reading, and voice interaction—so that enterprises and individual developers can more easily build comprehensive AI applications, even replicating an experience almost identical to the DeepSeek official app.

DeepSeek noted that developers only need to enable the corresponding parameters in the existing APIs to use these extended features. The company also simultaneously developed and open‑sourced a lightweight chat‑app demo, offering complete examples and even supporting the import of DeepSeek’s existing conversation history.

This update means developers no longer have to stitch together multiple third‑party services; they can integrate search, document reading, and voice interaction within a single chat interface, lowering the technical barrier to building AI applications.

DeepSeek opens core app functions – search and document parsing integrated via API. For ordinary users, the DeepSeek app is no longer just a simple chat tool. After a user asks a question, the system can search the web, read webpages, analyze uploaded documents, and then synthesize the information into an answer, involving multiple tool calls and data‑processing steps behind the scenes.

For third‑party developers, even if they have already integrated the DeepSeek model API, they still need to find a search service, develop document‑parsing tools, handle webpage content extraction, and coordinate data transfer among different tools. When faced with complex tasks, they must also manage multiple searches, data reading, and subsequent reasoning order and context integration.

This time DeepSeek consolidates those foundational tasks into its official service side. According to the announcement, the current V4.1‑Flash model (deepseek‑flash) now supports several extended capabilities across the Messages, Responses, and Chat Completions API categories.

Web search is one of the key features opened this time. When developers enable the deepseek_web_search tool, the model can automatically perform web or image searches in non‑thinking mode based on the user’s question and include source citations in its response.

If the deep thinking mode is enabled, the model can also conduct multi‑step reasoning, automatically searching the web, reading relevant links, and continuing its analysis based on the retrieved information.

Document handling is also included in this update. Developers can directly upload PDFs, Office files, and images; DeepSeek’s official service extracts plain text or performs mixed text‑image parsing, then passes the results to the model for analysis.

For external webpage reading, developers simply enable deepseek_read_url, and the model will automatically detect URLs in the user’s message, fetch the page content, and answer the question in the context of the conversation.

DeepSeek also provides model safety‑check parameters that perform basic risk screening on inputs and outputs; if a risk condition is met, the system returns a refusal flag. The company reminds developers offering external services to enable safety checks and fulfill related content‑safety review, large‑model registration, and AI labeling obligations.

In addition, Search, Fetch, OCR, ASR, and TTS functions are released as independent APIs, allowing developers to call them separately or combine them freely. For example, an educational app could first use OCR to recognize exam papers and then let DeepSeek explain the questions; a voice assistant could use ASR to convert spoken input to text for the model to understand, and finally generate a spoken reply via TTS.

To showcase the new APIs in practice, DeepSeek simultaneously developed and open‑sourced a lightweight chat demo. The company says that with the new APIs, developers can already build products whose functionality is essentially on par with the DeepSeek official app, and the demo even supports direct import of DeepSeek conversation history.
However, using these extended features still incurs fees. According to DeepSeek’s published pricing, developers must pay both the token cost of the model itself and the usage fees for the tool calls.
In other words, while developers can save on the development and maintenance of basic tools, the actual cost will still rise with increased model usage and the number of tool invocations.

DeepSeek: The Next Super‑App May Belong to a Single Person. By opening the API, DeepSeek makes it easier for third‑party developers to integrate the official product’s capabilities into their own applications. For DeepSeek, this means its models and tool services have the chance to appear in many scenarios beyond the official app.

DeepSeek Harness head Cui Tianyi posted on X that all core capabilities behind DeepSeek products are now available via API, and hopes that as the development barrier lowers, the developer community will create more diverse, complete, and imaginative products.
He also shared his view on future app development, suggesting that the next super‑app does not have to serve everyone; each individual could potentially build a super‑app tailored to themselves.

In the past, the pursuit of a super‑app in tech focused on massive user bases, rich features, and diverse use cases. With AI programming and agent technologies advancing, software development costs are gradually decreasing, and developers no longer need to build every foundational function from scratch.

In the future, users may be able to create highly personalized AI applications that fit their work and life habits. Such products may not require a large user base nor aim for commercialization, but instead provide services closely aligned with individual needs.

From the era when a few internet companies built a single app for millions of users to a future where many people can develop bespoke tools for their own needs, DeepSeek’s full opening of its application APIs is a step toward lowering these development barriers.

items.title: 美國問烏克蘭：願放棄頓巴斯換加入北約嗎？
items.title_en: U.S. Asks Ukraine: Will You Trade Donbas for NATO Membership?
paras: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基13日（周五）表示，在最近談判期間，美國代表詢問烏方是否願意從頓巴斯地區撤出軍隊，換取加入北約（NATO）。
據《基輔郵報》報導，澤倫斯基表示，美方在最近一輪外交會談中首次提出這個問題。
他指出，任何包含北約成員資格、具有約束力的安全保證和重建資金的具體方案，都會直接提交給烏克蘭公眾審議。烏方多次強調，不會撤退或放棄主權領土。
「如果美方與其他北約成員國一致向我國確認這一點，我會徵求社會意見：接受還是不接受？」他說，「我無權自行決定。」
澤倫斯基說道：「目前還需要具體細節，這些細節尚不明確，還都在討論中。」
他重申，烏方在任何情況下都不會在法律上承認俄佔烏東領土是俄羅斯的一部分。
paras_en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Friday the 13th that during recent negotiations, a U.S. representative asked whether Ukraine would be willing to withdraw its forces from the Donbas region in exchange for joining NATO.
According to the Kyiv Post, Zelensky said the United States raised this question for the first time in the latest round of diplomatic talks.

He noted that any concrete package that includes NATO membership, binding security guarantees and reconstruction funding would be submitted directly to the Ukrainian public for review. Kyiv has repeatedly stressed that it will not retreat from or relinquish its sovereign territory.
"If the United States and other NATO members confirm this to me collectively, I will seek public opinion: to accept or not?" he said, "I have no authority to decide on my own."
Zelensky added that specific details are still needed, and those details remain unclear and are still under discussion.
He reiterated that under no circumstances will Ukraine legally recognize the Russian‑occupied eastern Ukrainian territories as part of Russia.

items.title: 輝達醜聞使美商務部長盧特尼克面臨下台危機！《巴隆》恐牽動鋼鐵、加密貨幣與政府投資
paras: 美國商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick）因輝達(NVDA-US) 相關爭議遭到政府內外批評，傳出可能面臨去職危機。這場風波不僅牽涉美國對中國的晶片出口管制，也可能影響美國貿易政策、政府入股民間企業的布局，以及鋼鐵、加密貨幣與房貸金融等產業。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，爭議焦點在於，盧特尼克未將新加坡企業Megaspeed列入美國限制名單。該公司涉嫌協助將輝達先進晶片轉運至中國，藉此規避美國出口管制。
美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）週五（13日）接受《CNBC》訪問時，將矛頭指向商務部，批評該部門未將Megaspeed列入限制名單，導致該公司仍能取得美國技術。
盧特尼克預計將就此事赴參議院銀行委員會作證。預測市場Kalshi的交易者則估計，他今年卸任的機率達58%。
這起爭議也與輝達執行長黃仁勳本週辭職，以及他承認對妻子不忠的消息交織。此前有報導指出，黃仁勳曾與Megaspeed一名前高階主管黃樂（Alice Huang）發生婚外情，而美國正調查該名人士是否與中國情報機構有所關聯。

盧特尼克去留牽動鋼鐵、加密貨幣與房貸金融業

盧特尼克曾任金融服務公司Cantor Fitzgerald負責人，是川普在貿易談判、加密貨幣政策及華爾街相關議題上的重要幕僚，也主導美國政府擴大直接持有民間企業股權的政策。
Beacon Policy Advisors分析師Tedford指出，近幾個月盧特尼克介入美國與加拿大、墨西哥的貿易談判，力圖避免鋼鐵及鋁材關稅在更廣泛的貿易協議中遭到削弱。
這項立場有利於Cleveland-Cliffs與諾可(NUE-US) 等美國鋼鐵業者，兩家公司高層都曾將關稅視為支撐產業的重要因素。
在加密貨幣領域，盧特尼克同樣是產業支持者之一。去年，川普政府指派他等內閣官員研究如何增加政府持有的加密貨幣，配合川普提出的「戰略比特幣儲備」計畫；今年夏季國會審議有利加密貨幣產業的法案期間，他也曾與業者高層會面。
此外，盧特尼克與美國聯邦住房金融局（FHFA）局長普爾特（Bill Pulte）均支持出售房貸金融巨頭房利美（Fannie Mae）及房地美（Freddie Mac）部分股權。
報導指出，如果盧特尼克不再主掌商務部，上述三個產業的投資人可能面臨更高風險。

輝達風波恐讓美國政府入股企業政策加速

盧特尼克也是川普政府推動入股民間企業政策的主要設計者之一。不過，輝達風波未必會讓這項政策降溫，反而可能促使政府進一步擴大投資。
根據美國外交關係協會（CFR）資料，自2025年1月以來，美國政府已宣布49筆交易，涉及股權投資總額達308億美元，其中包括取得英特爾(INTC-US) 近10%股權。
Raymond James分析師Ed Mills指出，這些投資中有許多是為了降低美國對中國稀土及關鍵礦物供應的依賴。如果輝達醜聞促使川普對中國採取更強硬的立場，中國可能以限制稀土出貨作為反制，讓這類投資變得更加重要。
Mills表示，美中緊張局勢升高，「將加大美國建立自主供應鏈的壓力，也提高美國進一步加碼投資相關企業的可能性」。

items.title: Anthropic推Claude自託管代理！企業可將AI管理系統部署內部、降低雲端調度資安疑慮
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Managed Agents for Self‑Hosted Deployment, Enabling Enterprises to Run AI Management Systems Internally and Reduce Cloud Security Concerns
paras: Anthropic推出自託管版Claude託管代理（Claude Managed Agents），讓企業能將人工智慧（AI）代理的完整管理系統部署在自有私有雲或實體機房，不必再依賴Anthropic雲端伺服器調度任務。這項功能目前已開放私人測試，主要鎖定需要讓AI深入企業內部系統執行工作的用戶，協助解決核心程式碼與內部伺服器存取權限所帶來的資安疑慮。
隨著AI代理逐漸從對話工具轉向執行任務，應用範圍已延伸至程式碼修正、自動化部署與測試、監控警報分流，以及系統缺陷處理等工作。這類任務往往需要AI取得企業內部程式碼及伺服器的存取權限，也讓企業面臨新的安全與合規挑戰。
Anthropic過去提供的折衷方案，是讓企業在本地端執行虛擬沙箱，但代理的調度系統仍運作於Anthropic雲端。
新推出的自託管模式則進一步將調度伺服器、會話資料庫及執行沙箱都交由企業自行部署，使整套系統能在企業內部環境運作。

三層架構分工　任務調度、執行與資料儲存各自獨立

這套系統主要由三個部分組成。首先是調度伺服器，負責接收業務請求、維持代理的運作流程，以及分派各項任務，但不會直接執行程式碼或終端指令。
其次是執行沙箱與工人程序，負責接收調度伺服器下達的任務，並在獨立隔離環境中執行終端指令、讀取檔案及修改程式碼。每個沙箱都相當於獨立的工作環境，讓實際操作與任務調度分開。
第三部分則是資料庫。系統要求搭配企業自有的PostgreSQL資料庫，將代理設定、對話內容及歷史紀錄儲存在企業自己的硬碟中，即使調度伺服器重新啟動，也不會因此遺失過往的會話狀態。
至於哪些資料仍會離開企業內部網路，主要是在代理向大型語言模型（LLM）發出請求時，調度伺服器會將當下的對話脈絡及工具執行結果傳送至模型服務端。
企業也能依照自身合規需求選擇模型服務來源，包括Anthropic官方服務、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) AWS Bedrock、Google(GOOGL-US) Cloud、微軟(MSFT-US) Foundry，或自行架設的模型閘道。

三組密鑰分開管理　沙箱遭入侵也難以取得模型憑證

為避免權限集中造成風險，系統設計三種不同用途的密鑰。第一種是本地伺服器介面密鑰，供企業內部應用程式及管理工具使用，向自有調度伺服器下達指令。
第二種是模型呼叫憑證，僅保存在調度伺服器內部，用於連接遠端大型語言模型，執行沙箱中的工人程序無法取得這組憑證。
第三種是環境專屬密鑰，提供各個沙箱內的工人程序使用，讓它們能向本地調度伺服器取得所屬環境的任務。
透過這種權限分離設計，即使執行沙箱遭到入侵，攻擊者也無法直接取得調用大型語言模型所需的憑證。
不過，Anthropic也特別提醒，這套系統並不會自動替工人程序提供完整的安全防護。內建命令列工具具有實際系統權限，代理可以執行真正的終端指令，因此安全性完全取決於企業部署的沙箱環境。
Anthropic建議，企業應將工人程序放在一次性容器或虛擬機器中執行，任務完成後即予以銷毀。若直接在正式環境伺服器上執行，一旦代理發生誤操作，就可能對實際系統造成破壞。
這也代表，企業雖然能藉由自託管模式取得更高的系統控制權，但同時必須自行負責安全隔離、權限管理及資安稽核。
目前這套系統支援Linux及搭載蘋果(AAPL-US) 晶片的macOS環境。企業用戶可透過Anthropic業務團隊申請取得安裝套件與技術文件。
paras_en: Anthropic has introduced Claude Managed Agents, a self‑hosted version of its Claude AI agents, allowing enterprises to deploy the full AI‑agent management system on private clouds or on‑premises data centers instead of relying on Anthropic’s cloud servers for task scheduling. The feature is currently in private beta and targets users who need AI to operate deep within corporate systems, addressing security concerns around core code and internal server access.

As AI agents shift from conversational tools to task execution, their use cases now include code fixing, automated deployment and testing, alert routing, and system defect handling. These tasks often require the AI to access internal codebases and servers, presenting new security and compliance challenges for companies.
Anthropic’s previous compromise was to let enterprises run a virtual sandbox locally while the agent scheduling system still operated in Anthropic’s cloud.

The new self‑hosted mode pushes the scheduling server, conversation database, and execution sandbox all onto the enterprise’s own infrastructure, allowing the entire system to run inside the corporate environment.

The architecture is split into three layers—task scheduling, execution, and data storage—each operating independently. The scheduling server receives business requests, maintains the agent workflow, and dispatches tasks, but it does not execute code or terminal commands directly.

The execution layer consists of sandboxes and worker processes that receive tasks from the scheduler and run terminal commands, read files, and modify code within isolated environments. Each sandbox functions as a separate work environment, keeping actual execution separate from scheduling.

The third component is the database. The system requires the enterprise’s own PostgreSQL instance to store agent configurations, conversation content, and history on the company’s disks, ensuring that a scheduler restart does not lose prior session state.

Data that leaves the corporate network is limited to the context and tool results sent to the large language model (LLM) when the agent makes a request; the scheduling server forwards this information to the model service endpoint.

Enterprises can choose the model service source to meet compliance needs, including Anthropic’s own service, Amazon (AMZN‑US) AWS Bedrock, Google (GOOGL‑US) Cloud, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) Foundry, or a self‑hosted model gateway.
Three separate keys are managed to avoid centralized risk. The first is a local server interface key used by internal applications and management tools to issue commands to the on‑premises scheduler.
The second is a model‑call credential stored only inside the scheduler for connecting to remote LLMs; worker processes in the sandbox cannot access this credential.
The third is an environment‑specific key provided to each sandbox’s worker processes so they can retrieve tasks from the local scheduler for their own environment.
With this permission‑separation design, even if a sandbox is compromised, attackers cannot obtain the credentials needed to invoke the LLM.

Anthropic cautions that the system does not automatically provide full security for worker processes. Built‑in command‑line tools have real system privileges, and agents can execute genuine terminal commands, so security depends entirely on the sandbox environment the enterprise deploys.

Anthropic recommends running worker processes in disposable containers or virtual machines that are destroyed after task completion. Executing agents directly on production servers risks real‑world damage if the agent misbehaves.
Thus, while self‑hosting gives enterprises greater control, they must also assume responsibility for isolation, permission management, and security auditing.

The system currently supports Linux and macOS environments powered by Apple (AAPL‑US) silicon. Enterprise customers can request installation packages and technical documentation through Anthropic’s sales team.

items.title: 黃仁勳卸任前專訪曝！《彭博》紀錄片談AI安全、對中晶片與輝達接班布局
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Pre‑Resignation Interview Revealed! Bloomberg Documentary Discusses AI Safety, China Chip Exports, and Nvidia Succession Plans
paras: 《彭博》旗下Bloomberg Originals於11月12日推出最新紀錄片《The Rise and Reckoning of Jensen Huang》，由《The Circuit》主持人Emily Chang專訪輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳，記錄他對人工智慧（AI）產業發展、主權AI、對中國晶片出口、AI安全及公司接班布局的看法。
這部長達45分鐘的紀錄片於10月拍攝，Chang隨行走訪巴黎、倫敦、斯德哥爾摩及柏林，並在美國波特蘭的GTC大會繼續採訪。
當時黃仁勳仍是全球AI浪潮中最具影響力的企業領袖之一；然而，影片上線之際，輝達董事會已因相關報導啟動獨立調查，黃仁勳的離去也成為市場焦點，讓片中談及公司治理、接班與產業風險的內容再度受到關注。

從AI五層架構到主權AI　黃仁勳談全球布局

紀錄片中，黃仁勳將AI產業比喻為一個由五層組成的蛋糕，從底部往上依序為能源、晶片、基礎設施、模型及應用。輝達最初專注於第二層的晶片，如今則已向產業上下游擴大投資，布局AI生態系的不同環節。
他也在歐洲行程中積極推廣「主權AI」（Sovereign AI），主張各國應掌握自身資料、文化價值與機構知識，並有權決定自己的發展方向。
面對主持人質疑，若AI基礎設施仰賴美國晶片，是否仍能稱為主權AI，黃仁勳表示，主權的核心在於掌握自身的使用體驗，包括資料、企業運作、國家文化價值及人民的機構知識。
談及美中科技競爭，黃仁勳坦言，輝達如今已無法進入中國市場。他表示，自己一直努力向美國政策制定者說明參與中國市場的重要性，認為美國在這方面犯了錯誤，而且很難扭轉。
他也強調，中國並非美國的敵人。若各國真正關切AI安全，就應該展開對話，並在可能的範圍內合作。

AI安全與資本支出爭議　黃仁勳反駁產業風險疑慮

隨著AI代理（AI Agents）逐漸普及，AI系統的安全性與可控性也成為訪談重點。黃仁勳認為，提升AI能力與安全並不衝突，兩者必須同步推進。
他以AI模型產生幻覺為例指出，業界透過檢索增強生成（RAG）、擴大上下文窗口，以及讓模型連接工具等技術，改善模型回答的可靠性。
對於部分業者警告AI模型可能出現異常行為，甚至逃避關閉，黃仁勳主張，自主系統與具身系統必須受到嚴格限制及監控；如果無法確保這些條件，就不應進行測試或部署。但他不認同因此停止相關研究，認為應該設法控制並監督實驗。
紀錄片也觸及輝達在AI產業鏈中的投資及資本支出。黃仁勳表示，AI技術需要龐大資本投入，新一代AI新創企業往往需要數十億美元資金，而非僅靠1,000萬美元就能取得足夠支持。
他指出，輝達過去5年投入約1,000億美元，並帶動其他機構投資人投入至少相當於五倍的資金，進一步擴大AI生態系。
對於外界質疑輝達向AI企業投資、同時又向其銷售晶片，可能形成循環融資，黃仁勳並未在訪談中逐一回應個別交易，而是強調AI產業需要高額資本支出。他也不認為客戶對輝達的依賴構成系統性風險，表示客戶是自主選擇輝達，而公司必須每天重新贏得客戶支持。

談女兒接班傳聞　希望下一任執行長來自公司內部

談到個人管理風格，黃仁勳表示，他希望打造盡可能沒有官僚體系的組織，認為目前的管理方式有助於公司持續成長與創新。
對於外界傳聞女兒可能接任執行長，他表示不會強迫子女接班，因為這必須是他們自己的志向，也必須靠自身努力爭取。他坦言，自己當初決定擔任執行長時，並未充分理解這份職位所承受的壓力與責任。
黃仁勳表示，希望輝達下一任執行長已經在公司內部，並期待公司能持續培養下一代領導人才。他也強調，接班人必須靠自己的能力取得職位，就如同他自己也可能被解雇一樣。
不過，紀錄片上線前後，黃仁勳的個人處境出現重大變化。根據相關媒體報導，輝達董事會11月8日宣布啟動由獨立董事主導、外部律師協助的調查，並表示目前沒有理由認為相關事件危及國家安全或造成公司機密外洩，同時表達對黃仁勳及管理團隊的信任。
此後，《華爾街日報》報導董事會正準備解除黃仁勳的執行長職務，消息一度引發市場震盪。美國國會議員也要求黃仁勳就相關問題作出說明。
輝達週四（12日）宣布，黃仁勳辭任執行長並退出董事會，由財務長 Colette Kress 暫代執行長。
黃仁勳1993年共同創立輝達，現年63歲，持有公司約3.6%股份。輝達董事會共有11名成員，除黃仁勳外，其餘均為獨立董事。紀錄片中，他曾表示希望自己能在20年後仍保持健康，但更重要的是，公司必須持續培養能夠接班的領導人才。
paras_en: Bloomberg Originals released the documentary "The Rise and Reckoning of Jensen Huang" on November 12, featuring host Emily Chang interviewing Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang about the development of the AI industry, sovereign AI, China chip exports, AI safety, and the company’s succession strategy.
The 45‑minute film was shot in October, with Chang traveling to Paris, London, Stockholm, and Berlin, and continuing the interview at the GTC conference in Portland, USA.

At the time, Huang was still one of the most influential leaders in the global AI wave; however, by the time the film premiered, Nvidia’s board had launched an independent investigation in response to related reports, and Huang’s departure became a market focus, drawing renewed attention to the film’s discussion of corporate governance, succession, and industry risk.

In the documentary, Huang likened the AI industry to a five‑layer cake, from bottom to top: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, and applications. Nvidia initially focused on the second layer—chips—but has now expanded investments across the entire AI ecosystem.

During his European tour, he actively promoted the concept of "sovereign AI," arguing that each country should control its own data, cultural values, institutional knowledge, and have the right to determine its own development path.

When questioned by the host about whether AI infrastructure relying on U.S. chips could still be considered sovereign AI, Huang said that sovereignty centers on controlling the user experience, including data, business operations, national cultural values, and the people’s institutional knowledge.

On the U.S.–China tech rivalry, Huang admitted that Nvidia can no longer enter the Chinese market. He said he has always tried to explain to U.S. policymakers the importance of participating in China, that the U.S. has made a mistake in this area, and that it is difficult to reverse.
He also emphasized that China is not an enemy of the U.S. If countries truly care about AI safety, they should engage in dialogue and cooperate where possible.

With AI agents becoming more common, the safety and controllability of AI systems became a focus of the interview. Huang believes that improving AI capability and safety are not mutually exclusive and must progress together.
He cited hallucinations in AI models and explained that the industry uses retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), larger context windows, and tool‑connected models to improve answer reliability.

Regarding some vendors warning that AI models might behave abnormally or evade shutdown, Huang argued that autonomous and embodied systems must be strictly restricted and monitored; if those conditions cannot be ensured, testing or deployment should not proceed. He does not agree with halting research, believing that experiments should be controlled and supervised.

The documentary also touched on Nvidia’s investments and capital expenditures in the AI supply chain. Huang said that AI technology requires massive capital, and new AI startups often need billions of dollars, not just a hundred million, to get sufficient support.
He noted that Nvidia has invested about $100 billion over the past five years and has driven other investors to contribute at least five times that amount, further expanding the AI ecosystem.

When questioned about Nvidia’s potential circular financing by investing in AI companies while also selling chips to them, Huang did not address each transaction individually but emphasized the high capital requirements of the AI industry. He also does not see customer dependence on Nvidia as a systemic risk, stating that customers choose Nvidia independently and the company must win their support every day.

On personal management style, Huang said he wants to build an organization with as little bureaucracy as possible, believing that the current management approach helps the company continue to grow and innovate.

Regarding rumors that his daughter might succeed him as CEO, he said he would not force a child to take over, as it must be their own ambition and effort. He admitted that when he first became CEO, he did not fully understand the pressure and responsibility of the role.

Huang expressed that he hopes the next Nvidia CEO will already be inside the company and that the company should continue to nurture future leaders. He also stressed that the successor must earn the position through their own abilities, just as he could be fired.

However, after the documentary’s release, Huang’s personal situation changed dramatically. According to reports, Nvidia’s board announced on November 8 that it had launched an investigation led by independent directors with external lawyers, stating that there was no reason to believe the events threatened national security or caused a breach of company secrets, and expressed trust in Huang and the management team.

Subsequently, the Wall Street Journal reported that the board was preparing to remove Huang from the CEO position, a story that caused market turbulence. U.S. congressional members also demanded that Huang explain the related issues.
On Thursday (12th), Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang had resigned as CEO and left the board, with CFO Colette Kress acting as interim CEO.

Huang co‑founded Nvidia in 1993, is 63 years old, and holds about 3.6% of the company. The board has 11 members, all independent except for Huang. In the documentary, he said he hopes to remain healthy in 20 years, but more importantly, the company must continue to develop leaders capable of succession.

items.title: 歐盟擬限縮SpaceX星鏈頻譜資源！30兆赫僅開放10兆赫競標、馬斯克反彈
items.title_en: EU Plans to Restrict SpaceX Starlink Spectrum Resources! Only 10 MHz of 30 MHz Open for Bidding, Musk Pushes Back
paras: 歐盟正醞釀重新分配移動衛星服務頻譜，計畫將大部分資源保留給歐洲政府及本土業者，星鏈（Starlink）等國際業者只能競標部分頻寬。這項方案不僅引發SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克反彈，也讓美國對歐盟強化通訊自主的布局表達不滿，歐美之間的太空競爭可能因此升溫。
根據西班牙《世界報》報導，歐盟現行移動衛星服務頻段許可將於2027年5月到期，屆時相關頻譜將重新招標。不過，歐盟執委會提出的規劃，打算將總計30兆赫（MHz）的頻譜劃分為三部分：10兆赫供政府用途、10兆赫保留給一家歐洲業者提供商業服務，剩餘10兆赫則開放全球業者競標。
按照這項方案，星鏈只能競逐其中10兆赫。考量星鏈未來20年業務預期將大幅成長，能取得的頻譜資源卻遠少於目前，對此，馬斯克表示無法接受。
美國也對歐盟的規劃提出警告。美國駐歐盟大使普茲德（Andrew Puzder）幾周前表示，若布魯塞爾持續推動這項計畫，將帶來「毀滅性的後果」。不過，歐盟內部仍審慎看待推動方案的可能性，希望藉此提升自身在關鍵通訊領域的自主能力。
布魯蓋爾研究所（Bruegel）高級研究員 Guntram Wolff 指出，歐洲各國普遍憂心對美國依賴過深，降低這種依賴已成為各方迫切訴求，而重新分配頻譜正是其中一種途徑。

頻譜分配牽動歐洲自主通訊布局

報導稱，歐盟此舉的核心並非單純爭奪商業收益，而是希望降低在關鍵通訊基礎設施上對美國業者的依賴。規劃中保留給政府用途的10兆赫，主要是為歐洲衛星彈性、互聯性和安全性基礎設施計畫（Iris2）衛星星座預留。
Iris2由348顆衛星組成，目標是建立可與星鏈相抗衡的安全通訊系統。西班牙衛星公司是該計畫主要承建商之一，負責地面系統及超低軌道衛星星座，在相關頻譜服務中扮演重要角色。
西班牙衛星公司執行長 Luis Mayo 表示，歐盟可能進一步推動政府用途與歐洲商業服務用途的兩部分頻譜協同運作，以提高使用效率。這也意味著得標業者之間可能需要整合系統，或以共同營運的方式提供服務。
目前已有業者簽署協議，計畫組成歐洲業者聯盟共同競標，但該聯盟並無意自行建置衛星星座，而是打算將相關業務外包給第三方。此外，也有規模較小的企業表達參與意願，包括西班牙衛星物聯網公司。
該公司執行長 Carlos Riopedre 強調，歐洲本土業者的定義必須明確，不能只是在布魯塞爾設立辦公室、完成行政程序，就自稱是歐洲企業；真正的決策權必須留在歐洲，且不受第三國管轄。

歐盟方案仍待各方協商　美國影響力成變數

不過，這項規劃距離定案仍有一段距離。歐洲議會必須先形成自身立場，歐盟成員國也須取得共識。其中，成員國協商可能面臨更大阻力，因為頻譜許可過去一向由各國自行招標，相關收入歸各國政府，管理權也掌握在成員國手中；歐盟如今則希望透過立法改革，將部分權限收歸歐盟層級。
外界也關注美國可能施加的政治壓力，促使部分與現任美國政府關係較密切的歐盟成員國改變立場。英國同樣密切觀察事態發展。英國相關許可到期時間與歐盟相近，但已決定延長現有許可，待進一步了解歐盟方案的運作方式後再作考量。
面對衛星通訊市場擴張，電信業者的策略也逐漸分歧。一部分選擇與馬斯克合作，另一部分則採取防範措施，避免星鏈接觸自家客戶，以限制其市場擴張。
此外，SpaceX仍握有一項重要籌碼：歐洲衛星發射服務。目前歐洲新一代衛星星座面臨的主要瓶頸之一，就是發射能力。若發射管道受阻，歐洲相關計畫的成本將大幅增加，而歐洲目前尚無足以與SpaceX抗衡的衛星發射力量。
paras_en: The EU is preparing to reallocate spectrum for mobile satellite services, planning to keep most of the resources for European governments and domestic operators, while international players such as Starlink will only be able to bid for a portion of the bandwidth. The proposal has sparked a backlash from SpaceX (SPCX‑US) CEO Elon Musk and drawn criticism from the United States, which is displeased with the EU’s move to strengthen its own communications autonomy, potentially heating up the space rivalry between Europe and the U.S.

According to Spain’s El Mundo, the EU’s current licence for mobile satellite service bands expires in May 2027, after which the spectrum will be re‑tendered. The European Commission’s plan is to split the total 30 MHz of spectrum into three blocks: 10 MHz for government use, 10 MHz reserved for a single European operator to provide commercial services, and the remaining 10 MHz opened to global operators for bidding.

Under this scheme, Starlink would be limited to competing for only the 10 MHz block. Musk says he cannot accept a situation where, despite expecting a massive growth in its business over the next 20 years, Starlink would receive far less spectrum than it currently enjoys.

The United States also warned against the EU’s plan. U.S. Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder said a few weeks ago that if Brussels pushes ahead, it could have “devastating consequences.” Nevertheless, EU officials remain cautious about the likelihood of moving forward, hoping the measure will boost Europe’s autonomy in critical communications.

Bruegel senior fellow Guntram Wolff noted that many European countries are worried about over‑reliance on the United States, and reducing that dependence has become an urgent demand, with spectrum reallocation seen as one avenue to achieve it.

The report says the EU’s move is not simply about commercial profit but about reducing reliance on U.S. players for critical communications infrastructure. The 10 MHz set aside for government use is intended for the Iris 2 satellite constellation, a European satellite‑flexibility, interconnectivity and security infrastructure project.

Iris 2 will consist of 348 satellites and aims to create a secure communications system that can rival Starlink. A Spanish satellite company is one of the main contractors for the project, handling ground systems and the low‑Earth‑orbit satellite constellation and playing a key role in the related spectrum services.

Luis Mayo, CEO of the Spanish satellite firm, said the EU may further promote coordinated use of the two spectrum portions – government and European commercial – to improve efficiency. This could mean that winning bidders might need to integrate their systems or operate jointly to provide services.

Some operators have already signed agreements to form a European consortium that will bid together, but the consortium does not intend to build its own satellite constellation; instead it plans to outsource the relevant activities to a third party. Smaller companies, including a Spanish satellite IoT firm, have also expressed interest in participating.

Carlos Riopedre, CEO of that company, stressed that the definition of a European domestic operator must be clear – merely setting up an office in Brussels and completing administrative steps does not make a firm European; real decision‑making power must stay in Europe and not be subject to third‑country jurisdiction.

The EU proposal is still subject to negotiation, with U.S. influence a variable factor. The European Parliament must first adopt its position, and EU member states need to reach consensus. Negotiations may face strong resistance because spectrum licences have traditionally been awarded by individual countries, with revenues and management staying at the national level; the EU now seeks to shift part of that authority to the EU level through legislative reform.

Observers are also watching for possible political pressure from the United States that could sway EU members with close ties to the current U.S. administration. The United Kingdom is closely monitoring the situation as well. The UK’s licences expire around the same time as the EU’s, but it has decided to extend its existing licences while it studies how the EU scheme will operate before making further decisions.

As the satellite communications market expands, telecom operators’ strategies are diverging. Some are choosing to cooperate with Musk, while others are taking defensive measures to keep Starlink away from their customers in order to limit its market expansion.

SpaceX still holds a crucial bargaining chip: European satellite launch services. One of the main bottlenecks for Europe’s next‑generation satellite constellations is launch capacity. If launch pathways are blocked, the cost of European projects will rise sharply, and Europe currently lacks a launch capability that can compete with SpaceX.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉外資期貨做空未轉向前 題材股輪動維繫多方熱度
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Foreign Futures Short Positions Remain Unchanged, Thematic Stocks Rotate to Sustain Bullish Momentum
paras: 在台股連4周走跌合計重挫20%後，國安基金宣布進場，使本周加權指數強彈達3973點，收復5日線和10日線短期均線，漲幅達10%，下檔有撐的氣氛逐漸轉強，但又遭逢黃仁勳事件，令來回波動相當大，台股交易員提醒，外資期貨淨空單續增至已超過10萬口，隨著美股有壓，仍要注意短線有獲利者出場造成的壓力，若有行情先以個股或族群表現為主流。
上周加權指數反彈達10%，不過，外資仍賣超968億元與內資投信對作，呈現連7周賣超，主要賣超中鋼(2002-TW)和仁寶(2324-TW)均超過6萬張，力積電(6770-TW)和大成鋼(2027-TW)均逾4.6萬張，英業達(2356-TW)達3.2萬張，廣達(-TW)2.1萬張，元大台灣50正2(00631L-TW)近1.9萬張，台積電(2330-TW)和正新(2105-TW)均達1.7萬張。
反觀投信仍維持買超力道，本周主要集中在大型電子股和金控股，有助穩住大盤漲點，一周來買超中信金(2891-TW)近5.4萬張，南亞(1303-TW)4.2萬張，元大台灣50(0050-TW)近3萬張，國泰金(2882-TW)和富邦金(2881-TW)均逾2萬張，元大台灣50正2達1.6萬張，台積電近1.5萬張，台玻(1802-TW)1.2萬張，日月光投控(3711-TW)逾8000張。
台股交易員認為，九合一大選前的選前行情可望使大盤明顯具備下檔支撐，然而美股電子股因黃仁勳事件仍是餘波蕩漾，且大盤在過去一周大漲10%後面臨月線和季線的反壓，較好狀況是先量縮整理、多頭以題材股維持輪動熱度。
永豐投顧指出，加權指數處在月線、季線與半年線下方，月線與季線走勢向下正在形成壓力，均線排列仍未明朗，但是KD 指標上已交叉向上，在此位階很可能盤整；整體而言，短線反彈仍屬跌深後的修復階段，尚未重回多頭結構。
從籌碼面來看，外資 10 月賣超創下歷史單月新高，但在反彈過程卻未出現外資買超回補，從過往經驗來看，新波段的開始往往伴隨外資回補，因此需等外資轉買，加上新台幣止貶回升帶動更多海外資金回流台灣。
paras_en: After four consecutive weeks of declines that wiped out about 20% of the Taiwan index, the National Security Fund announced a buy-in, pushing the weighted index up sharply to 3,973 points this week, recapturing the 5‑day and 10‑day moving averages with a 10% gain. The lower‑level support gradually strengthened, but the market was hit by the Jensen Huang incident, causing large swings. Traders warned that foreign futures net short positions have risen to over 100,000 contracts; with pressure from the U.S. market, short‑term profit‑taking could add further pressure, so any rally may first be led by individual stocks or sector performances.

Last week the weighted index rebounded 10%, yet foreign investors still sold a net NT$96.8 billion, out‑selling domestic institutional investors for seven consecutive weeks. The biggest sells were China Steel (2002‑TW) and Compal (2324‑TW), each over 60,000 lots, followed by Largan Precision (6770‑TW) and Da‑Cheng Steel (2027‑TW) each above 46,000 lots, Inventec (2356‑TW) 32,000 lots, Quanta (‑TW) 21,000 lots, Yuanta Taiwan 50 Plus (00631L‑TW) nearly 19,000 lots, and both TSMC (2330‑TW) and Cheng Shin (2105‑TW) around 17,000 lots each.

Conversely, institutional investors kept net buying, focusing this week on large‑cap electronics and financial stocks, helping to anchor the market’s gains. Over the past week they bought net 54,000 lots of CTBC Financial Holding (2891‑TW), 42,000 lots of Nan Ya (1303‑TW), nearly 30,000 lots of Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), over 20,000 lots each of Cathay Financial (2882‑TW) and Fubon Financial (2881‑TW), 16,000 lots of Yuanta Taiwan 50 Plus, about 15,000 lots of TSMC, 12,000 lots of Taiwan Glass (1802‑TW), and more than 8,000 lots of ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW).

A Taiwan market trader believes that the pre‑election rally ahead of the “nine‑in‑one” election could give the index clear lower‑level support. However, U.S. tech stocks are still rattled by the Jensen Huang episode, and after the index’s 10% surge last week it now faces resistance from the monthly and quarterly moving averages. The best scenario is a contraction‑phase consolidation, with bulls keeping thematic‑stock rotation lively.

Yong‑Feng Investment Advisory notes that the weighted index sits below its monthly, quarterly and semi‑annual moving averages, with downward pressure forming on the monthly and quarterly trends. The moving‑average alignment is still unclear, but the KD indicator has already crossed upward, suggesting the market may linger in a sideways range at this level. Overall, the short‑term bounce is still a recovery phase after a deep decline and has not yet returned to a bullish structure.

From a chip‑flow perspective, foreign investors set a historic monthly net‑sell record in October, yet no net buying has appeared during the rebound. Historically, new upward waves often begin when foreign investors start to buy back, so a turn to net buying—combined with the New Taiwan dollar’s halt in depreciation and its subsequent appreciation—could attract more overseas capital back to Taiwan.

items.title: 竣邦Q3純益年增近1倍EPS1.79元創新高 Q4迎旺季訂單需求佳
items.title_en: Junbang Q3 Net Profit Nearly Doubles YoY, EPS NT$1.79 Hits Record High; Q4 Anticipates Strong Seasonal Order Demand
paras: 戶外機能性布料設計廠竣邦-KY(4442-TW)第三季稅後純益5830萬元，年增近1倍，每股純益1.79元，創歷史新高；前三季每股純益4.59元。公司看好，第四季進入旺季，且訂單需求良好，對後市展望樂觀。
竣邦表示，目前觀察品牌客戶訂單及拉貨需求維持良好，訂單能見度優於去年同期，隨著營運規模持續擴大、核心產品出貨成長及產品組合持續優化，對全年獲利表現深具信心，並以挑戰歷史最佳表現為目標。
展望2027年，竣邦表示，隨著主力品牌核心系列產品合作持續深化、新客戶與新應用領域加速拓展，以及越南織染二廠建置穩步推進，成長動能持續增強，將持續朝再創新高的目標邁進。
竣邦第三季營收6.36億元，年增77%，毛利率26%，年減3個百分點；營業利益7310.8萬元，年增100%，營業利益率11%，年增1個百分點；稅後純益5830萬元，年增99%。
竣邦說明，毛利率主要受成本端匯率變動影響，不過，受惠營收規模大幅擴大，單季毛利金額仍較去年同期成長30%。
竣邦前三季累計營收16.45億元，年增35%，毛利率27%，年減1個百分點；營業利益1.88億元，年增38%，營業利益率12%，年增1個百分點；稅後純益1.47億元，年增31%，每股純益4.59元。
竣邦10月營收1.89億元，年增66%；累計前10月營收18.35億元，年增37%，已超越2025年全年水準。
竣邦說明，10月營收成長主要來自近年重點發展的新客戶，隨合作由開發階段進入量產出貨，新客戶採用的產品品項及出貨量同步增加；前10月重點發展新客戶營收較去年同期成長近六成，占整體營收比重約兩成。
竣邦表示，目前新客戶涵蓋高端運動休閒、工裝及袋材等應用領域，在主力品牌之外形成新的營收來源，使公司客戶與產品組合更趨多元。
paras_en: Outdoor functional fabric design company Junbang-KY (4442-TW) posted a Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$58.3 million, up almost 100% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.79, a historic high; the EPS for the first three quarters was NT$4.59. The company is optimistic, noting that Q4 enters the peak season and order demand is strong, supporting a positive outlook.

Junbang said it currently sees brand‑client orders and pull‑forward demand remaining healthy, with order visibility better than the same period last year. As operating scale continues to expand, core product shipments grow and the product mix keeps improving, the company is confident about full‑year profitability and aims to challenge its best historical performance.

Looking ahead to 2027, Junbang said that as collaborations on core series products with major brands deepen, new customers and application areas expand rapidly, and the construction of its second weaving‑dyeing plant in Vietnam progresses steadily, growth momentum will keep strengthening, driving the company toward new record highs.

In Q3, Junbang recorded revenue of NT$636 million, up 77% YoY, with a gross margin of 26%, down 3 percentage points year‑over‑year; operating profit was NT$73.108 million, up 100% YoY, yielding an operating margin of 11%, up 1 percentage point; after‑tax net profit was NT$58.3 million, up 99% YoY.

Junbang explained that the gross margin was mainly affected by currency fluctuations on the cost side, but thanks to the large increase in revenue scale, the gross profit amount for the quarter still grew 30% compared with the same period last year.

For the first three quarters, Junbang’s cumulative revenue reached NT$1.645 billion, up 35% YoY, with a gross margin of 27%, down 1 percentage point; operating profit was NT$188 million, up 38% YoY, giving an operating margin of 12%, up 1 percentage point; after‑tax net profit was NT$147 million, up 31% YoY, with EPS of NT$4.59.
Junbang reported October revenue of NT$189 million, up 66% YoY; cumulative revenue for the first ten months was NT$1.835 billion, up 37% YoY, already surpassing the full‑year level of 2025.

Junbang said the October revenue growth mainly stemmed from newly developed key customers in recent years; as cooperation moved from development to mass production, the product items and shipment volumes from these new customers increased in tandem. Revenue from these key new customers in the first ten months grew nearly 60% YoY, accounting for about 20% of total revenue.

Junbang noted that its new customers now cover high‑end sports‑leisure, workwear and bag‑material applications, creating additional revenue streams beyond its core brands and making the company’s customer base and product portfolio more diversified.

items.title: 65歲投保上限刪除、產假延至3.5個月 性平法與就保法5大創新一表看
items.title_en: Removal of the 65‑Year‑Old Insurance Age Cap, Extension of Maternity Leave to 3.5 Months – Five Major Innovations in the Gender Equality and Employment Insurance Laws
paras: 立法院昨（13）日三讀通過《性別平等工作法》及《就業保險法》修正草案，讓政府推動的臺灣人口對策新戰略家庭支持篇友善職場往前邁向一大步。兩部法修正案自行政院5月28日送請立法院審議至今，經歷近6個月審查，其中性別平等工作法修正案計有130案，就業保險法修正案計有100案，為社會關注重大修法案。
經過立法院多次會議審查、協商會議及勞動部與立法委員無數次溝通與交換意見，終獲立法院各黨團支持，給予受僱者從懷孕、生產到育兒階段，全面升級保障。勞動部感謝立法院及各界支持，在經過與各民間團體、黨團及委員積極溝通與評估後，三讀通過兩部法修正案。
性別平等工作法全文共修正7條、新增2條，就業保險法全文共修正12條、新增4條，重點包含產假陪產假全延長、育兒照顧到8歲、育兒津貼6加3、升級育兒假60日、企業托育租稅優惠等。此舉期能達到打造育兒友善職場、促成雙親育兒分擔更加平等，以及政府擴大資源與制度創新三大核心目標。
在延長產假與陪產假方面，為保障女性受僱者分娩後有充裕產假休養恢復及進行育兒安排，本次修法將產假由8週增加為14週，這是歷經超過40年首度對產假天數進行大幅修正。同時，受僱者就未休完之產檢假可於產假後的工作日接著請休，更有利受僱者運用於產後檢查及母體恢復。
為有利配偶共同分擔從懷孕到生產對母嬰的照顧，本次修法將陪產檢及陪產假由原本的7日增加為14日，讓受僱者更多參與及陪伴配偶妊娠產檢、孕產教育課程、照顧新生兒與陪伴出院等。此外，懷孕三個月以下流產假天數增加，勞工可依個人意願及身體狀況請假或銷假，兼顧女性勞工健康與職場需求。
為減緩本次修法增加企業營運壓力與財務負擔，本次修正新增假期雇主依法應給付薪資部分，皆可向政府申請補貼，包含新增之產假第9週至第14週、三個月以下流產假2星期與10天、陪產檢及陪產假第8日到第14日。產假新增第9週到第14週受僱者可依其個人意願選擇向雇主提前銷假，尊重女性受僱者重返職場意願。
在育兒照顧年齡方面，勞動部在法案多次審查及協商期間，積極聽取民間團體及立法委員建議，考量兒童由幼兒園銜接至國民小學低年級階段，面臨群體生活適應及傳染疾病好發等挑戰。本次修法將育兒留職停薪的子女年齡由未滿3歲提高至8歲以下、滿9歲前得申請育兒留職停薪，期間以2年為限。
就業保險法修法部分另訂就業保險投保薪資分級表，進而提高級距上限，使保障更貼近勞工需求。同時擴大育兒留停津貼補助之期間，雙親領滿6個月津貼，可各再多請領3個月，最長可各請領至9個月，雙親合計可請領最高18個月的育兒留停津貼。
現行30日的以日育嬰留職停薪未來將升級加倍為60日育兒假，子女年齡與育兒留職停薪同為8歲以下。亦即子女滿9歲前，父母親面臨子女有生病、停托、停課、預防接種、托育與教保服務機構及學校舉辦親職活動，或其他事由須親自照顧者，得請育兒假。
實務上若雙親未能或不適宜實際負擔主要照顧責任，本次修法明文規定經法院選定或改定兒童之監護人包含祖父母，亦可請育兒留職停薪及育兒假，以保障孩童受照顧權益。本次於性別平等工作法增訂第23條之1，企業辦理托兒設施及托兒措施，得就其支出金額之百分之200自當年度所得額中減除。
透過租稅優惠有助於提升雇主辦理企業托育的意願，鼓勵更多企業投入職場托育服務，協助受僱者兼顧工作與家庭。就業保險法也因應鼓勵中高齡與高齡者促進就業政策，刪除65歲投保年齡上限，並將失業給付等待期由14日縮短為7日，讓失業勞工迅速領到給付。
法院三讀通過《性別平等工作法》與《就業保險法》修正案所涵蓋的友善職場修法工程「五大突破」詳細對照表：
paras_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the revised Gender Equality in Employment Act and Employment Insurance Act on the 13th, marking a major step forward for the government’s new population strategy that emphasizes family support and a friendly workplace. The two amendment bills, submitted by the Executive Yuan on May 28, underwent nearly six months of review, with 130 amendments to the Gender Equality Act and 100 to the Employment Insurance Act, making them high‑profile legislative reforms.

After multiple legislative sessions, negotiation meetings, and countless exchanges between the Ministry of Labor and legislators, the bills secured support from all party caucuses, delivering comprehensive upgraded protections for employees throughout pregnancy, childbirth, and child‑rearing. The Ministry of Labor thanked the Legislative Yuan and all stakeholders; following extensive dialogue and assessment with civil groups, party caucuses, and legislators, the amendments were approved on third reading.

The Gender Equality in Employment Act was amended with seven revisions and two new articles, while the Employment Insurance Act received twelve revisions and four new articles. Key changes include extending both maternity and paternity leave, expanding child‑care coverage to children under eight, a 6‑plus‑3 month child‑care allowance, upgrading child‑care leave to 60 days, and tax incentives for corporate child‑care facilities. The reforms aim to create child‑friendly workplaces, promote more equal sharing of parenting duties, and expand government resources and institutional innovation.

To ensure female employees have ample time to recover and arrange child‑rearing after delivery, the amendment lengthens statutory maternity leave from eight weeks to fourteen weeks – the first major increase in over four decades. Employees may also take any unused prenatal leave immediately after maternity leave, facilitating post‑natal check‑ups and maternal recovery.

To enable spouses to share care responsibilities from pregnancy through birth, paternity‑related prenatal leave and paternity leave are increased from seven to fourteen days, allowing employees to accompany partners to prenatal appointments, parenting classes, newborn care, and discharge visits. In addition, the number of days for miscarriage leave before the third month of pregnancy is increased, giving female workers flexibility to take or cancel leave based on personal health and circumstances.

To offset the added financial burden on businesses, the amendment adds that employers must pay wages for the newly created leave periods but may apply for government subsidies. Covered periods include weeks 9‑14 of maternity leave, two weeks plus ten days of miscarriage leave before three months, and days 8‑14 of paternity‑related leave. Employees may also choose to forfeit the later weeks of maternity leave early, respecting their desire to return to work.

Regarding the age limit for child‑care leave, the Ministry of Labor, after extensive consultation, raised the eligible age from under three years to under eight years, allowing applications for unpaid child‑care leave up to the child’s ninth birthday, with a maximum duration of two years per leave spell.

The Employment Insurance amendment introduces a tiered wage‑contribution table, raising the upper brackets to better match workers’ needs. It also expands the child‑care leave allowance period: after parents have received six months of benefits, each may claim an additional three months, up to a maximum of nine months per parent, or eighteen months combined.

The current 30‑day unpaid infant‑care leave will be upgraded to a 60‑day paid child‑care leave, with the same age limit of under eight years. Thus, before a child turns nine, parents can take child‑care leave for illness, daycare closure, school suspension, vaccinations, childcare‑service events, or any other reason requiring personal care.

If parents are unable or unsuitable to assume primary caregiving, the amendment explicitly allows court‑appointed or reassigned guardians—such as grandparents—to claim child‑care leave and allowances, safeguarding children’s right to care. The Gender Equality Act adds Article 23‑1, permitting companies that provide on‑site childcare facilities or measures to deduct 200 % of related expenses from their current‑year taxable income.

Tax incentives are intended to boost employers’ willingness to offer corporate childcare, encouraging more firms to provide on‑site services that help employees balance work and family. The Employment Insurance Act also responds to policies promoting employment for middle‑aged and senior workers by removing the 65‑year insurance age cap and shortening the unemployment‑benefit waiting period from 14 days to seven, enabling faster benefit receipt.

The third‑reading approval of the Gender Equality in Employment Act and Employment Insurance Act amendments outlines the “Five Major Breakthroughs” for creating a friendly workplace, presented in a detailed comparison table.

items.title: 資金大風吹！市場熱錢「賣輝達、轉台積」 專家揭台股下周攻防關鍵指標
items.title_en: Big Capital Surge! Hot Money Shifts from Nvidia to TSMC – Experts Reveal Key Indicators for Taiwan Stock Market Next Week
paras: 富蘭克林證券投顧的最新分析指出，本周 (周一至周四）全球金融市場經歷重大變局，美國期中選舉結果底定後政治不確定性消退，加上OpenAI與CoreWeave繳出亮眼財報，帶動美股四大指數走揚。然而市場隨後遭遇黑天鵝襲擊，輝達執行長黃仁勳因醜聞宣布辭職，引發半導體族群短線震盪。展望下周美國將公布重磅企業財報以及聯準會10月利率會議紀錄，將牽動全球與台股走勢。

在亞股表現方面，整體呈現台股獨強與亞股回穩格局，其中台股加權指數單周大漲10.01%，成為亞洲表現最強勁的市場。推升台股走強的核心動能來自於基本面與題材面雙重加持，包含台積電 (2330-TW) （TSM-US) 公布10月合併營收達新台幣5868.9億元，月增14.7%且年增高達59.7%，創下單月歷史新高，並同步宣布將向Anthropic與OpenAI投資最高10億美元，鞏固其全球AI軍火庫的核心地位。
其他亞股如日股受惠於企業財報與半導體設備商帶動上漲6.30%，韓股因記憶體大廠三星與SK海力士走強上揚4.58%，陸港股則受美國收緊AI晶片新規與經濟數據多空互見影響而拉回。
富蘭克林證券投顧表示，展望下周，美國將公布重磅企業財報包含11月17日輝達財報及多家大型零售商數據以及聯準會10月利率會議紀錄，將成為牽動全球與台股神經的關鍵。
針對投資人下周的布局策略，專家建議應聚焦台積電與AI核心供應鏈，儘管輝達領導層異動帶來短線波動，但AI長線需求與大型雲端服務商的資本支出未減，台廠在先進製程與硬體供應鏈的關鍵地位難以取代，建議投資人逢低布局台積電相關供應鏈與先進封裝、光通訊等族群。
同時，投資人也應留意財報與總經數據驗證，下周輝達財報與美國零售數據將檢視終端需求與AI變現能力，若股價因消息面拉回，反而是長線買盤進場的好時機，並可透過多元配置以分散風險，除台股與科技主軸外，亞洲新興市場如南韓、印度等具備內需或企業價值提升計畫的市場，亦可適度納入資產配置，平衡投資組合波動。
paras_en: Franklin Securities’ latest analysis notes that this week (Monday to Thursday) global financial markets underwent major shifts. After the U.S. midterm election results were settled, political uncertainty faded, and strong earnings from OpenAI and CoreWeave lifted the four major U.S. indices. The market then faced a black‑swans event when Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid scandal, sparking short‑term turbulence in the semiconductor sector. Looking ahead, next week’s U.S. corporate earnings releases and the Fed’s October rate‑policy meeting minutes will drive both global and Taiwan market moves.

In Asian equities, Taiwan stood out while other markets steadied. The Taiwan Weighted Index jumped 10.01% for the week, making it the strongest performer in Asia. The rally was powered by both fundamentals and thematic drivers, notably TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) reporting October consolidated revenue of NT$586.89 billion – up 14.7% month‑over‑month and 59.7% year‑over‑year, a record monthly high – and announcing up to $1 billion in investments in Anthropic and OpenAI to cement its role in the global AI arms race.

Other Asian markets also rose: Japan’s Nikkei gained 6.30% on corporate earnings and semiconductor‑equipment makers, South Korea’s KOSPI climbed 4.58% as memory giants Samsung and SK Hynix rallied, while China‑Hong Kong stocks pulled back amid tighter U.S. AI‑chip regulations and mixed economic data.

Franklin Securities says that next week’s key catalysts will be major U.S. earnings – including Nvidia’s report on November 17 and data from several large retailers – together with the Fed’s October minutes, which will be pivotal for global markets and Taiwan’s index.

For investors’ positioning next week, the expert advises focusing on TSMC and the core AI supply chain. Although Nvidia’s leadership change may cause short‑term volatility, long‑term AI demand and cloud‑provider capex remain robust, and Taiwan’s advanced‑process and hardware‑supply‑chain role is hard to replace. Investors should consider buying on dips into TSMC‑related suppliers, advanced packaging and optical‑communication stocks.

Investors should also watch earnings and macro data. Nvidia’s results and U.S. retail figures will test end‑user demand and AI monetisation. If the stock pulls back on news, it could be a good entry point for long‑term buyers. Diversify risk with multi‑asset allocation: beyond Taiwan and tech, consider Asian emerging markets such as South Korea and India, which have domestic‑demand or corporate‑value‑upgrade plans, to balance portfolio volatility.

items.title: 黃仁勳辭輝達執行長、MSCI調整台股增3刪4、台積電入股 Anthropic與OpenAI 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO, MSCI Adds 3 and Deletes 4 Taiwan Stocks, TSMC Invests in Anthropic and OpenAI – Weekly Highlights
paras: 黃仁勳周四(12日)辭去輝達執行長一職，改由財務長Colette Kress出任臨時執行長； MSCI明晟周四12日公布最新半年度調整，台灣指數成分股方面，新增3檔PCB股，另有4檔遭刪；台積電周二(10日) 宣布將分別以不超過 5 億美元的額度，認購 AI 模型開發商 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 的股份，以下為本周大事回顧：

黃仁勳辭職並退出董事會！輝達財務長暫代執行長 

輝達(NVDA-US)周四(12日)宣布，黃仁勳辭任執行長並退出董事會，由財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)暫代執行長。這項變動結束黃仁勳掌舵33年的時代，輝達盤前股價跌逾10%，拖累大盤。

〈MSCI調整〉PCB股獲青睞！台灣指數成分股增3刪4 南電、景碩、台燿新入列 

MSCI明晟周四(12日)公布最新半年度調整，台灣指數成分股方面，本次新增南電(8046-TW)、景碩(3189-TW)、台燿(6274-TW)，皆為PCB 相關供應鏈，同步刪除中租-KY(5871-TW)、嘉澤(3533-TW)、元太(8069-TW)、萬海(2615-TW)，指數成分股降為73檔，並有24檔成分股調整在外流通股數。

台積電Q3配息9元 核准資本預算409億美元 擬各砸5億美元入股Anthropic與OpenAI 

晶圓代工龍頭台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 董事會周二(10日)通過多項重大決議，包括核准配發 2026 年第三季每股現金股利 9.0 元、資本預算約 409.27 億美元，並首度宣布將分別以不超過 5 億美元的額度，認購 AI 模型開發商 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 的股份，同時斥資至多 5 億美元設立投資公司，布局半導體生態系。

〈鴻海法說〉劉揚偉：明年AI機櫃出貨高雙位數成長、市占率提升 將新增更多NeoCloud客戶 

鴻海(2317-TW)董事長劉揚偉周四(12日)於法說會表示，明年維持審慎樂觀看法，預期雙位數成長，雲端網路產品仍是最主要成長動能，其中，AI機櫃出貨可望維持高雙位數成長，並有更多新型雲端(NeoCloud)客戶加入，進一步提升AI伺服器市占率。

〈廣達法說〉明年AI伺服器營收年增高雙位數 整體伺服器營收占比上看9成 

廣達(2382-TW)周三(11日)召開法說會，公司表示，AI需求維持強勁，預期明年AI伺服器營收有望年增高雙位數百分比，且整體伺服器營收比重可達85至90%，並指出現階段AI相關訂單皆沒有變化，展望維持正面。

緯創前三季獲利428億元EPS 13.54元 加碼資本支出再擴充伺服器產能 

緯創(3231-TW)周三(11日)公告第三季財報，前三季稅後純益達428.6億元，年增超過1倍，每股純益13.54元。此外，緯創董事會也通過多項議案，拍板新增資本支出134.23億元，同步擴充台灣及墨西哥AI伺服器產能。
paras_en: Jensen Huang on Thursday (the 12th) stepped down as Nvidia's chief executive, with CFO Colette Kress taking over as interim CEO; MSCI announced its latest semi‑annual index adjustments on Thursday the 12th, adding three PCB stocks and deleting four from the Taiwan index; TSMC on Tuesday (the 10th) said it will invest up to $500 million each to purchase stakes in AI model developers Anthropic and OpenAI. Below is a review of this week’s major events:

Jensen Huang resigns and leaves the board! Nvidia CFO serves as interim CEO
Nvidia (NVDA‑US) announced on Thursday (the 12th) that Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO and stepped down from the board, with CFO Colette Kress acting as interim CEO. The change ends Huang’s 33‑year tenure, and Nvidia’s pre‑market share fell more than 10%, dragging down the broader market.

MSCI adjustment: PCB stocks favored! Taiwan index adds three, deletes four – Nanya, Jingshuo, TaiYao join
MSCI announced on Thursday (the 12th) its latest semi‑annual adjustments. For the Taiwan index, the three new constituents are Nanya Power (8046‑TW), Jingshuo (3189‑TW) and TaiYao (6274‑TW), all PCB‑related suppliers. At the same time, Zhongzu‑KY (5871‑TW), Jiaze (3533‑TW), Yuan Tai (8069‑TW) and Wan Hai (2615‑TW) were removed, reducing the index to 73 constituents, with 24 constituents seeing changes in free‑float shares.

TSMC Q3 dividend NT$9, approves $40.9 billion capital budget, plans up to $5 billion each for Anthropic and OpenAI stakes
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) board on Tuesday (the 10th) approved several major resolutions, including a cash dividend of NT$9 per share for Q3 2026, a capital budget of about $40.927 billion, and for the first time announced plans to invest up to $500 million each to acquire stakes in AI model developers Anthropic and OpenAI, as well as up to $500 million to set up an investment vehicle to build a semiconductor ecosystem.

Foxconn earnings call: Liu Yang‑wei says AI rack shipments to grow high‑double‑digit next year, market share to rise, more NeoCloud customers expected
Foxconn (2317‑TW) chairman Liu Yang‑wei told the earnings call on Thursday (the 12th) that the company remains cautiously optimistic for next year, expecting double‑digit growth. Cloud networking products remain the main growth driver, with AI rack shipments projected to maintain high‑double‑digit growth and new NeoCloud customers joining, further boosting AI server market share.

Quanta earnings call: AI server revenue to grow high‑double‑digit next year, overall server revenue to account for up to 90% of sales
Quanta (2382‑TW) held its earnings call on Wednesday (the 11th) and said AI demand stays strong, forecasting AI server revenue to grow at a high‑double‑digit annual rate next year, with overall server revenue expected to represent 85‑90% of total sales. The company noted that current AI‑related orders are unchanged and the outlook remains positive.

Wistron Q3 profit NT$42.86 billion, EPS NT$13.54; raises capital spending to expand server capacity
Wistron (3231‑TW) announced its third‑quarter results on Wednesday (the 11th), reporting a nine‑month net profit of NT$42.86 billion, more than double year‑over‑year, and earnings of NT$13.54 per share. The board also approved additional capital expenditures of NT$13.423 billion to further expand AI server capacity in Taiwan and Mexico.

items.title: 對標歐美日！臺灣實體互聯網聯盟成立 升級低碳物流、上下鏈即時共享資訊
items.title_en: Benchmarking the US, Europe, and Japan! Taiwan Physical Internet Alliance Established to Upgrade Low‑Carbon Logistics and Real‑Time Shared Information Across the Supply Chain
paras: 對全球供應鏈重組、勞動力短缺及淨零碳排等嚴峻挑戰，美國、歐盟、日本等主要國家已積極推動實體互聯網標準與共用容器體系。台灣同樣不落人後，經濟部商業發展署已委託工研院輔導業者運用SCOF平台，實現生產端、物流端與銷售端即時共享訂單及資訊，並以統一規格循環物流箱取代紙箱，全面助攻企業達成ESG減碳目標。
經濟部商業發展署與桃園市政府經濟發展局昨（13）日共同辦理「物流標準與共同化」專家座談會，活動由商業署署長蘇文玲與桃園市經發局長張誠共同主持。現場邀請產官學研專家，針對我國物流載具、容器與運具等標準制度需求進行深入交流，藉此全面精進並完善我國物流儲運服務與技術，提升產業整體競爭力。

商業發展署署長蘇文玲表示，物流服務是產業發展不可或缺的關鍵基礎設施。商業署近年積極推動「智慧物流國際鏈結」及「物流資材循環發展」等計畫，核心目標就是透過儲運互聯服務模式與技術，促進物流資源與資訊的跨業共享。現階段已委託工研院服科中心團隊輔導業者運用供應鏈訂單履行平台（Supply chain Order Fulfillment, SCOF），讓生產端、物流端和銷售端能即時共享訂單、運輸與倉儲資訊。
同時，商業署也持續推動以統一規格的「循環物流箱」來取代傳統的一次性紙箱，協助企業在營運過程中落實減碳。商業署指出，面對全球供應鏈勞動力短缺與淨零碳排壓力，美歐日等國已透過第三方協同組織推動實體互聯網標準與共用輸配送體系，在今年6月法國舉辦的國際實體互聯網會議中，各國專家也確認實體互聯網已邁向全球產業共識。
實體互聯網主要是透過物聯網、人工智慧與大數據分析，並應用標準化、模組化和網路連接原則，創造更有效率且永續的實體貨物運送系統。其目標在於減少運輸與倉儲行業的浪費及能源消耗，同時提高供應鏈的運作速度與可靠性，被國際社會視為解決物流碳排與效率瓶頸的最佳解方，對台灣產業轉型深具關鍵助益。
在座談會中，國內物流業者與公協會也正式共同成立「臺灣實體互聯網聯盟」。期望透過匯聚政府、產業與學術界的專業力量，共同研討物流容器與載具標準化、資訊共通與資源共享，以及跨業合作的商業模式。預期透過業者共同規劃與試行，將逐步促進物流資源共享的實踐，引領台灣企業邁向高效與低碳的新物流時代。
paras_en: In response to the severe challenges of global supply‑chain restructuring, labor shortages and net‑zero carbon goals, major economies such as the United States, the European Union and Japan have been actively promoting physical‑internet standards and shared‑container systems. Taiwan is keeping pace: the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Business Development Administration has commissioned the Industrial Technology Research Institute to guide companies in using the SCOF platform to achieve real‑time sharing of orders and information among production, logistics and sales, and to replace cardboard boxes with a unified‑specification circular logistics box, fully helping firms meet ESG carbon‑reduction targets.

The Business Development Administration and the Taoyuan City Government Economic Development Bureau jointly held an expert round‑table on “Logistics Standards and Commonization” yesterday (the 13th). The session was co‑hosted by Business Development Administration Director Su Wen‑ling and Taoyuan Economic Development Bureau Director Zhang Cheng. Experts from industry, government, academia and research were invited to discuss in depth the standards and system needs for Taiwan’s logistics carriers, containers and transport equipment, aiming to comprehensively refine and perfect the nation’s logistics storage‑transport services and technology and boost overall industry competitiveness.

Director Su Wen‑ling said that logistics services are an indispensable key infrastructure for industrial development. In recent years the Business Development Administration has actively promoted projects such as “Smart Logistics International Linkage” and “Circular Development of Logistics Materials,” whose core goal is to use storage‑transport inter‑connect services and technology to foster cross‑industry sharing of logistics resources and information. At present the agency has commissioned the ITRI Service Science Center team to guide firms in using the Supply Chain Order Fulfillment (SCOF) platform so that production, logistics and sales can share orders, transportation and warehousing information in real time.

At the same time, the agency continues to push a unified‑specification “circular logistics box” to replace traditional single‑use cardboard boxes, helping companies implement carbon‑reduction in their operations. The Business Development Administration notes that faced with global supply‑chain labor shortages and net‑zero pressure, the US, Europe and Japan have advanced physical‑internet standards and shared delivery‑distribution systems through third‑party collaborative organisations. At the International Physical Internet Conference held in France in June this year, experts from various countries confirmed that the physical internet is moving toward a global industry consensus.

The physical internet mainly leverages the Internet of Things, artificial intelligence and big‑data analytics, applying standardisation, modularisation and network‑connection principles to create a more efficient and sustainable system for moving physical goods. Its aim is to cut waste and energy consumption in transport and warehousing while speeding up and stabilising supply‑chain operations. The international community regards it as the best solution to logistics carbon emissions and efficiency bottlenecks, offering crucial assistance for Taiwan’s industrial transformation.

During the round‑table, domestic logistics firms and industry associations formally co‑founded the “Taiwan Physical Internet Alliance.” They hope to pool the expertise of government, industry and academia to jointly study standardisation of logistics containers and carriers, information interoperability, resource sharing and cross‑industry business models. It is expected that through joint planning and pilot projects, the alliance will gradually promote practical logistics‑resource sharing, leading Taiwanese enterprises into a new era of high‑efficiency, low‑carbon logistics.

items.title: 國泰人壽斥逾92億元布局倉儲、危老案 通過發債350億元
items.title_en: Cathay Life Insures Over NT$9.28 Billion for Warehouse and Aging‑Building Projects, Approves NT$35 Billion Bond Issue
paras: 國泰金控(2882-TW)代子公司國泰人壽發布重大訊息，宣布依保險法運用資金，與關係人簽訂兩項「自地委建」工程承攬契約，分別鎖定桃園物流倉儲與台北市精華區危老重建，總投資金額達新台幣92.83億元。此外，國壽董事會亦通過上限350億元的次順位公司債發行案，以厚實資本結構。
在物流地產布局方面，國泰人壽針對「桃園觀音忠愛段倉儲新建工程」，與旭源營造、艾立營造及關係人永聯物流開發簽訂承攬契約，工程總金額為67.95億元。
國泰人壽副總經理石敏宏表示，該案規劃興建地下1層、地上6層的大型物流中心，總樓地板面積近4萬坪，預計於2030年3月完工啟用。考量目前國內物流倉儲需求依然旺盛，未來招商將鎖定國內物流業者及具備倉儲配送需求的企業廠商。
另一項投資則聚焦台北市核心商業區，國泰人壽針對「台北市中山區榮星段民生復興危老重建工程」，與利害關係人三井工程簽約，契約金額為24.88億元，預計2032年3月15日完工。
石敏宏指出，該基地坐落於復興北路與民生東路交叉口，步行至捷運中山國中站僅約5分鐘，交通條件極佳。全案預計興建地下5層、地上20層的現代化辦公大樓，總樓地板面積約5,700坪，未來將瞄準有頂級或區域總部辦公需求的企業進行招租。
除了積極拓展不動產收益來源，國泰人壽董事會也決議通過，將以公開募集方式發行10年期(含)以上累積次順位普通公司債，發行總額上限為350億元。該筆發債計畫預計自董事會決議日起一年內，視市場利率行情及客觀金融情勢，採一次或分次方式發行。
paras_en: Cathay Financial Holding (2882‑TW) announced on behalf of its subsidiary Cathay Life Insurance that, in accordance with the Insurance Act, it will use its funds to sign two “self‑land‑construction” contracts with related parties, targeting a logistics warehouse in Taoyuan and an aging‑building redevelopment in a prime area of Taipei, with a total investment of NT$9.283 billion. The Cathay Life board also approved a subordinated corporate bond issuance capped at NT$35 billion to strengthen its capital structure.

In its logistics real‑estate expansion, Cathay Life signed construction contracts for the “Taoyuan Guanyin Zhong’ai Section New Warehouse Project” with Hsu‑Yuan Construction, Aili Construction and related party Yonglian Logistics Development, for a total contract value of NT$6.795 billion.

Deputy General Manager Shi Min‑hong said the project will build a large logistics centre with one underground level and six above‑ground floors, covering nearly 40,000 ping of floor area, and is slated for completion and operation in March 2030. Given the still‑strong domestic demand for logistics warehousing, future leasing will target local logistics firms and companies needing warehousing and distribution services.

Another investment focuses on Taipei’s core commercial district: Cathay Life signed a contract with stakeholder Mitsui Engineering for the “Zhongshan District Rongxing Section Minsheng‑Fuxing Aging‑Building Redevelopment Project,” valued at NT$2.488 billion, with completion expected on 15 March 2032.

Shi Min‑hong noted the site sits at the intersection of Fuxing North Road and Minsheng East Road, about a five‑minute walk from the Zhongshan Junior High School MRT station, offering excellent transport links. The full project will comprise five underground levels and twenty above‑ground floors of a modern office tower, about 5,700 ping of floor area, and will aim to lease to enterprises seeking premium or regional headquarters office space.

In addition to actively expanding real‑estate revenue sources, Cathay Life’s board also resolved to issue ten‑year (or longer) cumulative subordinated plain‑vanilla corporate bonds through a public offering, with a total issuance cap of NT$35 billion. The bond issuance is planned to be carried out within one year from the board’s decision, either in a single tranche or multiple tranches, depending on market interest rates and prevailing financial conditions.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉東捷資訊搭資安列車 周漲逾4成股價創新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Dongjie Information Rides the Cybersecurity Train, Weekly Rise Over 40% Sets New High
paras: 資訊軟體服務商近期股價走強，反映AI趨勢下帶動的資安需求，東捷資訊(6697-TW)正積極推廣相關服務方案，本周股價大漲達46%，股價衝出歷史新高80.6元，東捷資訊表示，將持續拓展零信任及AI資安、SOC資安服務與SAP CloudERP等業務。
在全球數位轉型與生成式AI浪潮下，企業與政府機構的資安風險擴大，群益投顧指出，IDC預估台灣資安市場規模將由2024年的4.62億美元提升至2028年的7.16億美元，主要是因勒索軟體、零時差攻擊和社交工程詐騙等威脅加速推升企業在端點偵測、雲端安全和威脅情報分析上的投入。
同時，台灣實施資通安全管理法，法規要求趨嚴，也提升了政府機關與金融業等對資安防護的剛性需求。
為因應自動化攻擊工具普及，資安廠商正加速導入AI於SOC監控、日誌分析和威脅情資整合，並帶動企業端加大對資安的支出。
東捷資訊第三季合併營收約3.46億元，年增約4.1%，每股純益(EPS)0.64元，與去年同期相近，前三季營收10.58億元，年增3.6%，EPS 2.5元。
東捷資訊認為，隨著AI應用快速普及，企業資安風險同步升高，因此，會透過既有客戶擴充與非SAP客戶開發雙軌並進，來加大力道發展資安版圖。
paras_en: Software services provider Dongjie Information (6697‑TW) has seen its stock surge 46% this week, breaking a historic high of NT$80.6 as it actively promotes cybersecurity solutions amid rising AI‑driven demand.

Amid the global digital transformation and generative AI wave, cyber‑risk for enterprises and government agencies is expanding. According to QFII Investment Advisory, IDC forecasts Taiwan’s cybersecurity market to grow from US$462 million in 2024 to US$716 million in 2028, driven by ransomware, zero‑day attacks and social‑engineering scams that boost spending on endpoint detection, cloud security and threat‑intelligence analysis.

At the same time, Taiwan’s implementation of the Information Security Management Act tightens regulations, increasing the rigid demand for cyber protection among government bodies and the financial sector.

To counter the proliferation of automated attack tools, cybersecurity vendors are accelerating AI adoption in SOC monitoring, log analysis and threat‑intelligence integration, prompting enterprises to increase their security spending.

Dongjie Information reported third‑quarter consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.46 billion, up about 4.1% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.64, roughly flat with the same period last year. For the first three quarters, revenue reached NT$10.58 billion, a 3.6% annual increase, and EPS was NT$2.5.

Dongjie Information believes that as AI applications proliferate, corporate cyber‑risk rises in tandem, so it will expand both existing client relationships and develop non‑SAP customers in parallel to aggressively grow its cybersecurity footprint.

items.title: 特斯拉Cybercab開放個人訂購 售價3萬美元
items.title_en: Tesla Opens Personal Orders for Cybercab at $30,000
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 宣布向受邀客戶開放Cybercab訂購用於「個人用途」，售價約3萬美元，客戶需要支付1,000美元訂金，且必須訂閱每月299美元自動駕駛服務。
首批交付預定將於12月開始，但初期範圍僅限於美國德州5座城市以及指定區域。
特斯拉執行長馬斯克表示，隨著監管審批陸續通過，Cybercab將逐步向全美用戶開放。
不過，他也表示，每月299美元訂閱費用「太高了」，定價應與特斯拉其他車型上FSD及聯網服務費用相當，即每月約115美元。
馬斯克上周曾說，Cybercab未來還會實現一系列效率提升，使電池組容量能降至40kWh。特斯拉還會採用液態銀作為車身顏色，讓整體色彩不會過於單調。
馬斯克重申，Cybercab生產優先級高於Cybertruck。「如果我們必須維持Cybertruck複雜的產線和供應鏈，並為其持續投入工程技術人員，那麼這些人才、工廠和設備就無法用於擴大Cybercab產能。而Cybercab才是真正能夠徹底改變全球陸地交通運輸格局的車型。」
Cybercab作為特斯拉Robotaxi車隊未來主力，配備剪刀門（又稱蝴蝶門），車內沒方向盤、沒油門和剎車踏板，也沒後視鏡。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) announced that invited customers can now order the Cybercab for personal use at a price of about $30,000, with a $1,000 deposit required and a mandatory $299 per month autonomous driving subscription.
The first deliveries are slated to begin in December, initially limited to five cities in Texas and designated areas within the state.
CEO Elon Musk said that as regulatory approvals come through, the Cybercab will be gradually opened to users across the United States.

However, he also noted that the $299 monthly subscription fee is "too high" and should be priced similarly to Tesla's other models' Full Self‑Driving and connectivity services, roughly $115 per month.

Musk said last week that the Cybercab will eventually incorporate a series of efficiency improvements, reducing battery pack capacity to 40 kWh, and will use liquid silver as a body color to avoid a monotonous appearance.

Musk reiterated that Cybercab production takes priority over the Cybertruck, stating that if resources remain tied to the complex Cybertruck production line and its engineering staff, those people, factories, and equipment cannot be used to expand Cybercab capacity, and that Cybercab is the model that can truly transform global land transportation.

The Cybercab, envisioned as the future backbone of Tesla's robotaxi fleet, features scissor (butterfly) doors and an interior without a steering wheel, accelerator or brake pedals, and no rear‑view mirrors.

items.title: 輝達醜聞使美商務部長盧特尼克面臨下台危機！《巴隆》恐牽動鋼鐵、加密貨幣與政府投資
paras: 美國商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick）因輝達(NVDA-US) 相關爭議遭到政府內外批評，傳出可能面臨去職危機。這場風波不僅牽涉美國對中國的晶片出口管制，也可能影響美國貿易政策、政府入股民間企業的布局，以及鋼鐵、加密貨幣與房貸金融等產業。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，爭議焦點在於，盧特尼克未將新加坡企業Megaspeed列入美國限制名單。該公司涉嫌協助將輝達先進晶片轉運至中國，藉此規避美國出口管制。
美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）週五（13日）接受《CNBC》訪問時，將矛頭指向商務部，批評該部門未將Megaspeed列入限制名單，導致該公司仍能取得美國技術。
盧特尼克預計將就此事赴參議院銀行委員會作證。預測市場Kalshi的交易者則估計，他今年卸任的機率達58%。
這起爭議也與輝達執行長黃仁勳本週辭職，以及他承認對妻子不忠的消息交織。此前有報導指出，黃仁勳曾與Megaspeed一名前高階主管黃樂（Alice Huang）發生婚外情，而美國正調查該名人士是否與中國情報機構有所關聯。

盧特尼克去留牽動鋼鐵、加密貨幣與房貸金融業

盧特尼克曾任金融服務公司Cantor Fitzgerald負責人，是川普在貿易談判、加密貨幣政策及華爾街相關議題上的重要幕僚，也主導美國政府擴大直接持有民間企業股權的政策。
Beacon Policy Advisors分析師Tedford指出，近幾個月盧特尼克介入美國與加拿大、墨西哥的貿易談判，力圖避免鋼鐵及鋁材關稅在更廣泛的貿易協議中遭到削弱。
這項立場有利於Cleveland-Cliffs與諾可(NUE-US) 等美國鋼鐵業者，兩家公司高層都曾將關稅視為支撐產業的重要因素。
在加密貨幣領域，盧特尼克同樣是產業支持者之一。去年，川普政府指派他等內閣官員研究如何增加政府持有的加密貨幣，配合川普提出的「戰略比特幣儲備」計畫；今年夏季國會審議有利加密貨幣產業的法案期間，他也曾與業者高層會面。
此外，盧特尼克與美國聯邦住房金融局（FHFA）局長普爾特（Bill Pulte）均支持出售房貸金融巨頭房利美（Fannie Mae）及房地美（Freddie Mac）部分股權。
報導指出，如果盧特尼克不再主掌商務部，上述三個產業的投資人可能面臨更高風險。

輝達風波恐讓美國政府入股企業政策加速

盧特尼克也是川普政府推動入股民間企業政策的主要設計者之一。不過，輝達風波未必會讓這項政策降溫，反而可能促使政府進一步擴大投資。
根據美國外交關係協會（CFR）資料，自2025年1月以來，美國政府已宣布49筆交易，涉及股權投資總額達308億美元，其中包括取得英特爾(INTC-US) 近10%股權。
Raymond James分析師Ed Mills指出，這些投資中有許多是為了降低美國對中國稀土及關鍵礦物供應的依賴。如果輝達醜聞促使川普對中國採取更強硬的立場，中國可能以限制稀土出貨作為反制，讓這類投資變得更加重要。
Mills表示，美中緊張局勢升高，「將加大美國建立自主供應鏈的壓力，也提高美國進一步加碼投資相關企業的可能性」。

items.title: GLP-1減重藥太貴保險難負擔 CVS：月費降至350美元才有機會打平
items.title_en: GLP-1 Weight‑Loss Drugs Too Expensive for Insurers; CVS Says Monthly Price Must Drop Below $350 to Break Even
paras: 2026年11月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ GLP-1減重藥有助改善患者健康，也可能減少後續住院及急診支出，但高昂藥價仍讓美國企業健康保險難以全面給付。美國醫療保健集團CVS Health(CVS-US)最新研究估算，若GLP-1藥物每月價格降至350美元以下，保險計畫因患者減少就醫而節省的醫療費用，才有機會抵銷新增藥費。
目前藥費距離這個門檻還有一段差距。美國員工福利研究所（EBRI）2025年估計，企業雇主及其他健康保險計畫支付的GLP-1藥物淨成本，約為每人每30天617至766美元，高於CVS估算的350美元。CVS並未透露旗下保險計畫實際支付的平均價格。
CVS追蹤約4,000名持續使用GLP-1藥物三年的患者，發現每人三年累計醫療費用比未用藥的相似患者少9,400美元，但處方藥支出卻多出13,300美元。兩者相抵後，保險計畫平均仍須多負擔3,900美元。
也就是說，保險計畫替患者支付藥費後，雖然可能因患者較少住院或急診而省下部分醫療費用，但節省金額仍不足以彌補藥費增加。CVS估算，若每月藥價降至350美元以下，節省的醫療費用才有機會抵銷藥費，讓企業擴大給付更符合成本效益。
CVS這項研究使用旗下Aetna健康保險的理賠資料，比較2023年至2025年間開始使用GLP-1藥物的患者，以及健康條件相近但未使用藥物的族群，最長追蹤三年。研究涵蓋肥胖、糖尿病及其他疾病患者，使用藥物包括禮來Eli Lilly(LLY-US)的Mounjaro、Zepbound，以及諾和諾德Novo Nordisk(NVO-US)的Ozempic、Wegovy。
藥費能否抵銷，也與患者原本的健康狀況有關。CVS首席醫療長Amy Compton-Phillips指出，住院風險較高的患者，若用藥後減少重大醫療事件，保險計畫可能較快看到費用節省效果；原本健康風險較低的患者，則可能需要更長時間，才能抵銷持續用藥的成本。
研究也發現，使用GLP-1藥物與較少的急診及住院次數有關。由於這是觀察性研究，尚無法直接證明醫療支出下降完全由藥物造成，且未單獨公布肥胖患者的結果。
CVS預計於11月15日在美國HLTH醫療產業大會發表研究結果。對美國企業雇主及健康保險業者而言，未來是否擴大GLP-1給付範圍，除了藥物療效，還須衡量藥價、患者健康風險及長期使用成本。

paras_en: November 14, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – GLP-1 weight‑loss drugs improve patient health and could reduce future hospital and emergency‑room costs, but their high price makes it difficult for U.S. corporate health insurers to cover them fully. CVS Health’s latest study estimates that only if the monthly price falls below $350 will the medical‑cost savings from fewer doctor visits offset the added drug expense.

The price is still far above that threshold. The Employee Benefit Research Institute (EBRI) projected that in 2025 corporate employers and other health plans will pay a net cost of $617‑$766 per person per 30 days for GLP‑1 drugs, well above CVS’s $350 estimate. CVS did not disclose the actual average price its plans pay.

CVS tracked about 4,000 patients who continuously used GLP‑1 drugs for three years and found that each person’s total medical costs over three years were $9,400 lower than similar patients who did not use the drugs, but prescription drug spending was $13,300 higher. After offsetting the two, insurers still had to shoulder an average extra $3,900 per member.

In other words, even after insurers pay for the medication, the savings from fewer hospitalizations or ER visits are not enough to cover the higher drug cost. CVS estimates that only if the monthly price drops below $350 will the saved medical expenses have a chance to offset the drug cost, making broader coverage more cost‑effective for companies.

The study used claims data from CVS’s Aetna health insurance, comparing patients who started GLP‑1 therapy between 2023 and 2025 with a matched cohort who did not use the drugs, with follow‑up up to three years. The analysis covered patients with obesity, diabetes and other conditions, using drugs such as Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro and Zepbound and Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic and Wegovy.

Whether drug costs can be offset also depends on patients’ baseline health. CVS chief medical officer Amy Compton‑Phillips said that high‑risk patients who avoid major medical events after treatment may show cost‑savings more quickly, whereas lower‑risk patients may take longer for the savings to outweigh the ongoing drug expense.

The research also found that GLP‑1 use was associated with fewer ER visits and hospital admissions. Because this is an observational study, it cannot prove that the reduction in medical spending is solely caused by the drugs, and results for obesity‑only patients were not reported separately.

CVS plans to present the findings at the HLTH conference in the United States on November 15. For corporate employers and health insurers, decisions about expanding GLP‑1 coverage will have to weigh not only efficacy but also price, patient health risk and long‑term cost.
