items.title: Anthropic推Claude自託管代理！企業可將AI管理系統部署內部、降低雲端調度資安疑慮
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Managed Agents for Self‑Hosted Deployment, Enabling Enterprises to Run AI Management Systems Internally and Reduce Cloud Security Concerns
paras: Anthropic推出自託管版Claude託管代理（Claude Managed Agents），讓企業能將人工智慧（AI）代理的完整管理系統部署在自有私有雲或實體機房，不必再依賴Anthropic雲端伺服器調度任務。這項功能目前已開放私人測試，主要鎖定需要讓AI深入企業內部系統執行工作的用戶，協助解決核心程式碼與內部伺服器存取權限所帶來的資安疑慮。
隨著AI代理逐漸從對話工具轉向執行任務，應用範圍已延伸至程式碼修正、自動化部署與測試、監控警報分流，以及系統缺陷處理等工作。這類任務往往需要AI取得企業內部程式碼及伺服器的存取權限，也讓企業面臨新的安全與合規挑戰。
Anthropic過去提供的折衷方案，是讓企業在本地端執行虛擬沙箱，但代理的調度系統仍運作於Anthropic雲端。
新推出的自託管模式則進一步將調度伺服器、會話資料庫及執行沙箱都交由企業自行部署，使整套系統能在企業內部環境運作。

三層架構分工　任務調度、執行與資料儲存各自獨立

這套系統主要由三個部分組成。首先是調度伺服器，負責接收業務請求、維持代理的運作流程，以及分派各項任務，但不會直接執行程式碼或終端指令。
其次是執行沙箱與工人程序，負責接收調度伺服器下達的任務，並在獨立隔離環境中執行終端指令、讀取檔案及修改程式碼。每個沙箱都相當於獨立的工作環境，讓實際操作與任務調度分開。
第三部分則是資料庫。系統要求搭配企業自有的PostgreSQL資料庫，將代理設定、對話內容及歷史紀錄儲存在企業自己的硬碟中，即使調度伺服器重新啟動，也不會因此遺失過往的會話狀態。
至於哪些資料仍會離開企業內部網路，主要是在代理向大型語言模型（LLM）發出請求時，調度伺服器會將當下的對話脈絡及工具執行結果傳送至模型服務端。
企業也能依照自身合規需求選擇模型服務來源，包括Anthropic官方服務、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) AWS Bedrock、Google(GOOGL-US) Cloud、微軟(MSFT-US) Foundry，或自行架設的模型閘道。

三組密鑰分開管理　沙箱遭入侵也難以取得模型憑證

為避免權限集中造成風險，系統設計三種不同用途的密鑰。第一種是本地伺服器介面密鑰，供企業內部應用程式及管理工具使用，向自有調度伺服器下達指令。
第二種是模型呼叫憑證，僅保存在調度伺服器內部，用於連接遠端大型語言模型，執行沙箱中的工人程序無法取得這組憑證。
第三種是環境專屬密鑰，提供各個沙箱內的工人程序使用，讓它們能向本地調度伺服器取得所屬環境的任務。
透過這種權限分離設計，即使執行沙箱遭到入侵，攻擊者也無法直接取得調用大型語言模型所需的憑證。
不過，Anthropic也特別提醒，這套系統並不會自動替工人程序提供完整的安全防護。內建命令列工具具有實際系統權限，代理可以執行真正的終端指令，因此安全性完全取決於企業部署的沙箱環境。
Anthropic建議，企業應將工人程序放在一次性容器或虛擬機器中執行，任務完成後即予以銷毀。若直接在正式環境伺服器上執行，一旦代理發生誤操作，就可能對實際系統造成破壞。
這也代表，企業雖然能藉由自託管模式取得更高的系統控制權，但同時必須自行負責安全隔離、權限管理及資安稽核。
目前這套系統支援Linux及搭載蘋果(AAPL-US) 晶片的macOS環境。企業用戶可透過Anthropic業務團隊申請取得安裝套件與技術文件。
paras_en: Anthropic has introduced Claude Managed Agents, a self‑hosted version of its Claude AI agents, allowing enterprises to deploy the full AI‑agent management system on private clouds or on‑premises data centers instead of relying on Anthropic’s cloud servers for task scheduling. The feature is currently in private beta and targets users who need AI to operate deep within corporate systems, addressing security concerns around core code and internal server access.

As AI agents shift from conversational tools to task execution, their use cases now include code fixing, automated deployment and testing, alert routing, and system defect handling. These tasks often require the AI to access internal codebases and servers, presenting new security and compliance challenges for companies.
Anthropic’s previous compromise was to let enterprises run a virtual sandbox locally while the agent scheduling system still operated in Anthropic’s cloud.

The new self‑hosted mode pushes the scheduling server, conversation database, and execution sandbox all onto the enterprise’s own infrastructure, allowing the entire system to run inside the corporate environment.

The architecture is split into three layers—task scheduling, execution, and data storage—each operating independently. The scheduling server receives business requests, maintains the agent workflow, and dispatches tasks, but it does not execute code or terminal commands directly.

The execution layer consists of sandboxes and worker processes that receive tasks from the scheduler and run terminal commands, read files, and modify code within isolated environments. Each sandbox functions as a separate work environment, keeping actual execution separate from scheduling.

The third component is the database. The system requires the enterprise’s own PostgreSQL instance to store agent configurations, conversation content, and history on the company’s disks, ensuring that a scheduler restart does not lose prior session state.

Data that leaves the corporate network is limited to the context and tool results sent to the large language model (LLM) when the agent makes a request; the scheduling server forwards this information to the model service endpoint.

Enterprises can choose the model service source to meet compliance needs, including Anthropic’s own service, Amazon (AMZN‑US) AWS Bedrock, Google (GOOGL‑US) Cloud, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) Foundry, or a self‑hosted model gateway.
Three separate keys are managed to avoid centralized risk. The first is a local server interface key used by internal applications and management tools to issue commands to the on‑premises scheduler.
The second is a model‑call credential stored only inside the scheduler for connecting to remote LLMs; worker processes in the sandbox cannot access this credential.
The third is an environment‑specific key provided to each sandbox’s worker processes so they can retrieve tasks from the local scheduler for their own environment.
With this permission‑separation design, even if a sandbox is compromised, attackers cannot obtain the credentials needed to invoke the LLM.

Anthropic cautions that the system does not automatically provide full security for worker processes. Built‑in command‑line tools have real system privileges, and agents can execute genuine terminal commands, so security depends entirely on the sandbox environment the enterprise deploys.

Anthropic recommends running worker processes in disposable containers or virtual machines that are destroyed after task completion. Executing agents directly on production servers risks real‑world damage if the agent misbehaves.
Thus, while self‑hosting gives enterprises greater control, they must also assume responsibility for isolation, permission management, and security auditing.

The system currently supports Linux and macOS environments powered by Apple (AAPL‑US) silicon. Enterprise customers can request installation packages and technical documentation through Anthropic’s sales team.

items.title: 黃仁勳卸任前專訪曝！《彭博》紀錄片談AI安全、對中晶片與輝達接班布局
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Pre‑Resignation Interview Revealed! Bloomberg Documentary Discusses AI Safety, China Chip Exports, and Nvidia Succession Plans
paras: 《彭博》旗下Bloomberg Originals於11月12日推出最新紀錄片《The Rise and Reckoning of Jensen Huang》，由《The Circuit》主持人Emily Chang專訪輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳，記錄他對人工智慧（AI）產業發展、主權AI、對中國晶片出口、AI安全及公司接班布局的看法。
這部長達45分鐘的紀錄片於10月拍攝，Chang隨行走訪巴黎、倫敦、斯德哥爾摩及柏林，並在美國波特蘭的GTC大會繼續採訪。
當時黃仁勳仍是全球AI浪潮中最具影響力的企業領袖之一；然而，影片上線之際，輝達董事會已因相關報導啟動獨立調查，黃仁勳的離去也成為市場焦點，讓片中談及公司治理、接班與產業風險的內容再度受到關注。

從AI五層架構到主權AI　黃仁勳談全球布局

紀錄片中，黃仁勳將AI產業比喻為一個由五層組成的蛋糕，從底部往上依序為能源、晶片、基礎設施、模型及應用。輝達最初專注於第二層的晶片，如今則已向產業上下游擴大投資，布局AI生態系的不同環節。
他也在歐洲行程中積極推廣「主權AI」（Sovereign AI），主張各國應掌握自身資料、文化價值與機構知識，並有權決定自己的發展方向。
面對主持人質疑，若AI基礎設施仰賴美國晶片，是否仍能稱為主權AI，黃仁勳表示，主權的核心在於掌握自身的使用體驗，包括資料、企業運作、國家文化價值及人民的機構知識。
談及美中科技競爭，黃仁勳坦言，輝達如今已無法進入中國市場。他表示，自己一直努力向美國政策制定者說明參與中國市場的重要性，認為美國在這方面犯了錯誤，而且很難扭轉。
他也強調，中國並非美國的敵人。若各國真正關切AI安全，就應該展開對話，並在可能的範圍內合作。

AI安全與資本支出爭議　黃仁勳反駁產業風險疑慮

隨著AI代理（AI Agents）逐漸普及，AI系統的安全性與可控性也成為訪談重點。黃仁勳認為，提升AI能力與安全並不衝突，兩者必須同步推進。
他以AI模型產生幻覺為例指出，業界透過檢索增強生成（RAG）、擴大上下文窗口，以及讓模型連接工具等技術，改善模型回答的可靠性。
對於部分業者警告AI模型可能出現異常行為，甚至逃避關閉，黃仁勳主張，自主系統與具身系統必須受到嚴格限制及監控；如果無法確保這些條件，就不應進行測試或部署。但他不認同因此停止相關研究，認為應該設法控制並監督實驗。
紀錄片也觸及輝達在AI產業鏈中的投資及資本支出。黃仁勳表示，AI技術需要龐大資本投入，新一代AI新創企業往往需要數十億美元資金，而非僅靠1,000萬美元就能取得足夠支持。
他指出，輝達過去5年投入約1,000億美元，並帶動其他機構投資人投入至少相當於五倍的資金，進一步擴大AI生態系。
對於外界質疑輝達向AI企業投資、同時又向其銷售晶片，可能形成循環融資，黃仁勳並未在訪談中逐一回應個別交易，而是強調AI產業需要高額資本支出。他也不認為客戶對輝達的依賴構成系統性風險，表示客戶是自主選擇輝達，而公司必須每天重新贏得客戶支持。

談女兒接班傳聞　希望下一任執行長來自公司內部

談到個人管理風格，黃仁勳表示，他希望打造盡可能沒有官僚體系的組織，認為目前的管理方式有助於公司持續成長與創新。
對於外界傳聞女兒可能接任執行長，他表示不會強迫子女接班，因為這必須是他們自己的志向，也必須靠自身努力爭取。他坦言，自己當初決定擔任執行長時，並未充分理解這份職位所承受的壓力與責任。
黃仁勳表示，希望輝達下一任執行長已經在公司內部，並期待公司能持續培養下一代領導人才。他也強調，接班人必須靠自己的能力取得職位，就如同他自己也可能被解雇一樣。
不過，紀錄片上線前後，黃仁勳的個人處境出現重大變化。根據相關媒體報導，輝達董事會11月8日宣布啟動由獨立董事主導、外部律師協助的調查，並表示目前沒有理由認為相關事件危及國家安全或造成公司機密外洩，同時表達對黃仁勳及管理團隊的信任。
此後，《華爾街日報》報導董事會正準備解除黃仁勳的執行長職務，消息一度引發市場震盪。美國國會議員也要求黃仁勳就相關問題作出說明。
輝達週四（12日）宣布，黃仁勳辭任執行長並退出董事會，由財務長 Colette Kress 暫代執行長。
黃仁勳1993年共同創立輝達，現年63歲，持有公司約3.6%股份。輝達董事會共有11名成員，除黃仁勳外，其餘均為獨立董事。紀錄片中，他曾表示希望自己能在20年後仍保持健康，但更重要的是，公司必須持續培養能夠接班的領導人才。
paras_en: Bloomberg Originals released the documentary "The Rise and Reckoning of Jensen Huang" on November 12, featuring host Emily Chang interviewing Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang about the development of the AI industry, sovereign AI, China chip exports, AI safety, and the company’s succession strategy.
The 45‑minute film was shot in October, with Chang traveling to Paris, London, Stockholm, and Berlin, and continuing the interview at the GTC conference in Portland, USA.

At the time, Huang was still one of the most influential leaders in the global AI wave; however, by the time the film premiered, Nvidia’s board had launched an independent investigation in response to related reports, and Huang’s departure became a market focus, drawing renewed attention to the film’s discussion of corporate governance, succession, and industry risk.

In the documentary, Huang likened the AI industry to a five‑layer cake, from bottom to top: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, and applications. Nvidia initially focused on the second layer—chips—but has now expanded investments across the entire AI ecosystem.

During his European tour, he actively promoted the concept of "sovereign AI," arguing that each country should control its own data, cultural values, institutional knowledge, and have the right to determine its own development path.

When questioned by the host about whether AI infrastructure relying on U.S. chips could still be considered sovereign AI, Huang said that sovereignty centers on controlling the user experience, including data, business operations, national cultural values, and the people’s institutional knowledge.

On the U.S.–China tech rivalry, Huang admitted that Nvidia can no longer enter the Chinese market. He said he has always tried to explain to U.S. policymakers the importance of participating in China, that the U.S. has made a mistake in this area, and that it is difficult to reverse.
He also emphasized that China is not an enemy of the U.S. If countries truly care about AI safety, they should engage in dialogue and cooperate where possible.

With AI agents becoming more common, the safety and controllability of AI systems became a focus of the interview. Huang believes that improving AI capability and safety are not mutually exclusive and must progress together.
He cited hallucinations in AI models and explained that the industry uses retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), larger context windows, and tool‑connected models to improve answer reliability.

Regarding some vendors warning that AI models might behave abnormally or evade shutdown, Huang argued that autonomous and embodied systems must be strictly restricted and monitored; if those conditions cannot be ensured, testing or deployment should not proceed. He does not agree with halting research, believing that experiments should be controlled and supervised.

The documentary also touched on Nvidia’s investments and capital expenditures in the AI supply chain. Huang said that AI technology requires massive capital, and new AI startups often need billions of dollars, not just a hundred million, to get sufficient support.
He noted that Nvidia has invested about $100 billion over the past five years and has driven other investors to contribute at least five times that amount, further expanding the AI ecosystem.

When questioned about Nvidia’s potential circular financing by investing in AI companies while also selling chips to them, Huang did not address each transaction individually but emphasized the high capital requirements of the AI industry. He also does not see customer dependence on Nvidia as a systemic risk, stating that customers choose Nvidia independently and the company must win their support every day.

On personal management style, Huang said he wants to build an organization with as little bureaucracy as possible, believing that the current management approach helps the company continue to grow and innovate.

Regarding rumors that his daughter might succeed him as CEO, he said he would not force a child to take over, as it must be their own ambition and effort. He admitted that when he first became CEO, he did not fully understand the pressure and responsibility of the role.

Huang expressed that he hopes the next Nvidia CEO will already be inside the company and that the company should continue to nurture future leaders. He also stressed that the successor must earn the position through their own abilities, just as he could be fired.

However, after the documentary’s release, Huang’s personal situation changed dramatically. According to reports, Nvidia’s board announced on November 8 that it had launched an investigation led by independent directors with external lawyers, stating that there was no reason to believe the events threatened national security or caused a breach of company secrets, and expressed trust in Huang and the management team.

Subsequently, the Wall Street Journal reported that the board was preparing to remove Huang from the CEO position, a story that caused market turbulence. U.S. congressional members also demanded that Huang explain the related issues.
On Thursday (12th), Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang had resigned as CEO and left the board, with CFO Colette Kress acting as interim CEO.

Huang co‑founded Nvidia in 1993, is 63 years old, and holds about 3.6% of the company. The board has 11 members, all independent except for Huang. In the documentary, he said he hopes to remain healthy in 20 years, but more importantly, the company must continue to develop leaders capable of succession.

items.title: 歐盟擬限縮SpaceX星鏈頻譜資源！30兆赫僅開放10兆赫競標、馬斯克反彈
items.title_en: EU Plans to Restrict SpaceX Starlink Spectrum Resources! Only 10 MHz of 30 MHz Open for Bidding, Musk Pushes Back
paras: 歐盟正醞釀重新分配移動衛星服務頻譜，計畫將大部分資源保留給歐洲政府及本土業者，星鏈（Starlink）等國際業者只能競標部分頻寬。這項方案不僅引發SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克反彈，也讓美國對歐盟強化通訊自主的布局表達不滿，歐美之間的太空競爭可能因此升溫。
根據西班牙《世界報》報導，歐盟現行移動衛星服務頻段許可將於2027年5月到期，屆時相關頻譜將重新招標。不過，歐盟執委會提出的規劃，打算將總計30兆赫（MHz）的頻譜劃分為三部分：10兆赫供政府用途、10兆赫保留給一家歐洲業者提供商業服務，剩餘10兆赫則開放全球業者競標。
按照這項方案，星鏈只能競逐其中10兆赫。考量星鏈未來20年業務預期將大幅成長，能取得的頻譜資源卻遠少於目前，對此，馬斯克表示無法接受。
美國也對歐盟的規劃提出警告。美國駐歐盟大使普茲德（Andrew Puzder）幾周前表示，若布魯塞爾持續推動這項計畫，將帶來「毀滅性的後果」。不過，歐盟內部仍審慎看待推動方案的可能性，希望藉此提升自身在關鍵通訊領域的自主能力。
布魯蓋爾研究所（Bruegel）高級研究員 Guntram Wolff 指出，歐洲各國普遍憂心對美國依賴過深，降低這種依賴已成為各方迫切訴求，而重新分配頻譜正是其中一種途徑。

頻譜分配牽動歐洲自主通訊布局

報導稱，歐盟此舉的核心並非單純爭奪商業收益，而是希望降低在關鍵通訊基礎設施上對美國業者的依賴。規劃中保留給政府用途的10兆赫，主要是為歐洲衛星彈性、互聯性和安全性基礎設施計畫（Iris2）衛星星座預留。
Iris2由348顆衛星組成，目標是建立可與星鏈相抗衡的安全通訊系統。西班牙衛星公司是該計畫主要承建商之一，負責地面系統及超低軌道衛星星座，在相關頻譜服務中扮演重要角色。
西班牙衛星公司執行長 Luis Mayo 表示，歐盟可能進一步推動政府用途與歐洲商業服務用途的兩部分頻譜協同運作，以提高使用效率。這也意味著得標業者之間可能需要整合系統，或以共同營運的方式提供服務。
目前已有業者簽署協議，計畫組成歐洲業者聯盟共同競標，但該聯盟並無意自行建置衛星星座，而是打算將相關業務外包給第三方。此外，也有規模較小的企業表達參與意願，包括西班牙衛星物聯網公司。
該公司執行長 Carlos Riopedre 強調，歐洲本土業者的定義必須明確，不能只是在布魯塞爾設立辦公室、完成行政程序，就自稱是歐洲企業；真正的決策權必須留在歐洲，且不受第三國管轄。

歐盟方案仍待各方協商　美國影響力成變數

不過，這項規劃距離定案仍有一段距離。歐洲議會必須先形成自身立場，歐盟成員國也須取得共識。其中，成員國協商可能面臨更大阻力，因為頻譜許可過去一向由各國自行招標，相關收入歸各國政府，管理權也掌握在成員國手中；歐盟如今則希望透過立法改革，將部分權限收歸歐盟層級。
外界也關注美國可能施加的政治壓力，促使部分與現任美國政府關係較密切的歐盟成員國改變立場。英國同樣密切觀察事態發展。英國相關許可到期時間與歐盟相近，但已決定延長現有許可，待進一步了解歐盟方案的運作方式後再作考量。
面對衛星通訊市場擴張，電信業者的策略也逐漸分歧。一部分選擇與馬斯克合作，另一部分則採取防範措施，避免星鏈接觸自家客戶，以限制其市場擴張。
此外，SpaceX仍握有一項重要籌碼：歐洲衛星發射服務。目前歐洲新一代衛星星座面臨的主要瓶頸之一，就是發射能力。若發射管道受阻，歐洲相關計畫的成本將大幅增加，而歐洲目前尚無足以與SpaceX抗衡的衛星發射力量。
paras_en: The EU is preparing to reallocate spectrum for mobile satellite services, planning to keep most of the resources for European governments and domestic operators, while international players such as Starlink will only be able to bid for a portion of the bandwidth. The proposal has sparked a backlash from SpaceX (SPCX‑US) CEO Elon Musk and drawn criticism from the United States, which is displeased with the EU’s move to strengthen its own communications autonomy, potentially heating up the space rivalry between Europe and the U.S.

According to Spain’s El Mundo, the EU’s current licence for mobile satellite service bands expires in May 2027, after which the spectrum will be re‑tendered. The European Commission’s plan is to split the total 30 MHz of spectrum into three blocks: 10 MHz for government use, 10 MHz reserved for a single European operator to provide commercial services, and the remaining 10 MHz opened to global operators for bidding.

Under this scheme, Starlink would be limited to competing for only the 10 MHz block. Musk says he cannot accept a situation where, despite expecting a massive growth in its business over the next 20 years, Starlink would receive far less spectrum than it currently enjoys.

The United States also warned against the EU’s plan. U.S. Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder said a few weeks ago that if Brussels pushes ahead, it could have “devastating consequences.” Nevertheless, EU officials remain cautious about the likelihood of moving forward, hoping the measure will boost Europe’s autonomy in critical communications.

Bruegel senior fellow Guntram Wolff noted that many European countries are worried about over‑reliance on the United States, and reducing that dependence has become an urgent demand, with spectrum reallocation seen as one avenue to achieve it.

The report says the EU’s move is not simply about commercial profit but about reducing reliance on U.S. players for critical communications infrastructure. The 10 MHz set aside for government use is intended for the Iris 2 satellite constellation, a European satellite‑flexibility, interconnectivity and security infrastructure project.

Iris 2 will consist of 348 satellites and aims to create a secure communications system that can rival Starlink. A Spanish satellite company is one of the main contractors for the project, handling ground systems and the low‑Earth‑orbit satellite constellation and playing a key role in the related spectrum services.

Luis Mayo, CEO of the Spanish satellite firm, said the EU may further promote coordinated use of the two spectrum portions – government and European commercial – to improve efficiency. This could mean that winning bidders might need to integrate their systems or operate jointly to provide services.

Some operators have already signed agreements to form a European consortium that will bid together, but the consortium does not intend to build its own satellite constellation; instead it plans to outsource the relevant activities to a third party. Smaller companies, including a Spanish satellite IoT firm, have also expressed interest in participating.

Carlos Riopedre, CEO of that company, stressed that the definition of a European domestic operator must be clear – merely setting up an office in Brussels and completing administrative steps does not make a firm European; real decision‑making power must stay in Europe and not be subject to third‑country jurisdiction.

The EU proposal is still subject to negotiation, with U.S. influence a variable factor. The European Parliament must first adopt its position, and EU member states need to reach consensus. Negotiations may face strong resistance because spectrum licences have traditionally been awarded by individual countries, with revenues and management staying at the national level; the EU now seeks to shift part of that authority to the EU level through legislative reform.

Observers are also watching for possible political pressure from the United States that could sway EU members with close ties to the current U.S. administration. The United Kingdom is closely monitoring the situation as well. The UK’s licences expire around the same time as the EU’s, but it has decided to extend its existing licences while it studies how the EU scheme will operate before making further decisions.

As the satellite communications market expands, telecom operators’ strategies are diverging. Some are choosing to cooperate with Musk, while others are taking defensive measures to keep Starlink away from their customers in order to limit its market expansion.

SpaceX still holds a crucial bargaining chip: European satellite launch services. One of the main bottlenecks for Europe’s next‑generation satellite constellations is launch capacity. If launch pathways are blocked, the cost of European projects will rise sharply, and Europe currently lacks a launch capability that can compete with SpaceX.

items.title: 微軟Outlook、Teams全球大當機終於修好了！超千名工程師連夜搶修、逾70國受影響
items.title_en: Microsoft Outlook and Teams Global Outage Finally Fixed! Over a Thousand Engineers Worked Overnight, Over 70 Countries Affected
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US) 表示，旗下旗艦軟體服務已全面恢復正常，結束這場導致全球各地政府機關、交易員及企業營運陷入癱瘓的服務中斷事件。此次受影響的服務包括Outlook、Teams及人工智慧（AI）工具Copilot。用戶週五遭遇會議邀請未送達、網頁無法正常回應等問題。相較之下，微軟過去的服務中斷事件鮮少持續超過數小時。
根據《彭博》報導，微軟在官方服務狀態頁面表示，目前所有產品均已恢復運作，Microsoft 365服務中積壓的電子郵件也已完成處理，相關問題獲得解決。
微軟發言人表示，這次錯誤是在網路容量升級期間引入的。從公司服務狀態頁面每小時發布的更新內容來看，微軟在釐清問題根源的過程中，曾多次嘗試但未能成功解決。
超過1,000名工程師及其他員工參與視訊會議，由雲端事業主管Scott Guthrie，以及負責M365軟體套件和其他工作場所應用程式的Charles Lamanna主持。會議從週四（12日）深夜持續至週五（13日）上午。
作為M365套件中電子郵件及行事曆服務運作核心的Exchange，在伺服器啟動後會迅速耗盡可用資源，導致系統無法回應。知情人士透露，工程師曾調查應用程式是否錯誤地將流量傳送至資料庫，而非本機記憶體。部分人則懷疑，問題可能出在微軟Azure雲端網路的設定錯誤。
微軟對外表示，將在服務中斷事件結束後提供更多細節，並強調目前沒有證據顯示事件涉及惡意活動。發言人也指出，這次故障與AI或AI代理（agents）無關。
Lamanna在電子郵件聲明中表示：「我們知道客戶每天都仰賴我們的服務完成重要工作，對於這次服務中斷對依賴我們服務的用戶造成影響，我們深感抱歉。我們的團隊正在檢視事件經過，並研究如何防止類似問題再次發生。」
根據故障追蹤網站Downdetector，這次服務中斷波及全球，超過70個國家的用戶回報問題，累計通報數達數十萬筆。
從東京、倫敦到紐約，各地辦公室及政府機關員工都設法因應突發狀況，不少人不得不重新拿起電話，甚至使用紙本等20世紀的傳統工具。美國各地企業員工則將Outlook當機形容為「成人版的雪假」（adult snow day）。
與此同時，使用Google(GOOGL-US) Workspace的員工看著Outlook用戶暫時無所事事，不禁心生羨慕。
但企業管理層面臨的情況截然不同。瑞士精品集團歷峰（Richemont）及美國卡車與巴士製造商主力集團(WKHS-US) 等企業，因服務中斷被迫延後公布財報。警方及醫院等關鍵服務也受到影響。知情人士透露，英國國民保健署（NHS）因此重新安排部分醫療程序。
微軟服務首次出現異常的跡象，約在美國東岸時間週四下午1時浮現，Downdetector通報數隨即快速攀升。許多不滿的用戶湧入社群平台抱怨，也有人聯想到過去多起大型雲端服務中斷事件。
去年亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 網路服務（AWS）曾發生長達15小時的服務中斷，影響數百個網站。2024年資安公司Crowdstrike(CRWD-US) 因軟體更新出錯，導致全球航班停飛及各地資訊系統癱瘓，造成數十億美元損失。
此次微軟故障的波及範圍雖不及前述事件，但對企業營運仍造成實質影響。例如，擁有Calvin Klein及Tommy Hilfiger品牌的服飾集團PVH週四宣布將裁減全球約4%的員工，但原定週五上午在亞洲展開的部分裁員溝通會議，因服務中斷未能如期舉行，讓員工暫時無法得知自身職位的後續安排。
這次事件也再次引發外界對企業過度依賴單一科技供應商的疑慮。微軟的Windows作業系統及生產力工具，在AI時代仍是許多企業不可或缺的基礎設施，而Microsoft 365商用用戶已超過4.5億人。
William Blair & Co.分析師Jason Ader在研究報告中寫道：「考量到替換已深度整合至企業工作流程中的生產力工具，涉及高昂成本及複雜程序，我們不認為這起事件短期內會對微軟的競爭地位造成重大影響。」
不過，他也指出：「從長期來看，這可能讓部分客戶更願意接受替代方案，尤其是Google Workspace，以及Anthropic本週稍早公布的新興生產力工具。」
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) said its flagship software services have fully recovered, ending a service disruption that left government agencies, traders and businesses worldwide paralyzed. Affected services included Outlook, Teams and the AI tool Copilot. Users on Friday experienced issues such as meeting invites not being delivered and web pages not responding. Compared with past outages, Microsoft’s incidents rarely last more than a few hours.
According to Bloomberg, Microsoft’s official service status page now shows all products back online and the backlog of emails in Microsoft 365 has been cleared, resolving the related problems.

A Microsoft spokesperson said the error was introduced during a network capacity upgrade. Hourly updates on the company’s service status page showed multiple attempts to resolve the issue while the root cause was being investigated.

More than 1,000 engineers and other staff joined a video call hosted by cloud‑business leader Scott Guthrie and M365 suite head Charles Lamanna. The meeting ran from late Thursday night (the 12th) into Friday morning (the 13th).

Exchange, the core email and calendar service in the M365 suite, quickly exhausted available resources after the server started, causing the system to become unresponsive. Insiders said engineers looked into whether the application was mistakenly routing traffic to the database instead of local memory, while some suspect a misconfiguration in Microsoft Azure’s cloud network.

Microsoft said it will provide more details after the outage ends and stressed there is no evidence the incident involved malicious activity. The spokesperson also noted the failure was unrelated to AI or AI agents.

Lamanna wrote in an email statement: “We know customers rely on our services every day to get important work done. We deeply regret the impact this outage has had on users who depend on us. Our team is reviewing the incident and studying how to prevent similar problems in the future.”
Downdetector, a outage‑tracking site, reported the outage affected users in more than 70 countries, with total reports reaching hundreds of thousands.

From Tokyo to London to New York, office and government workers scrambled to cope, many having to pick up the phone again or even resort to paper‑based tools from the 20th century. U.S. employees described the Outlook crash as an “adult snow day.”
At the same time, employees using Google (GOOGL‑US) Workspace watched Outlook users sit idle and couldn’t help feeling a bit envious.

But the impact on corporate management was very different. Companies such as Swiss luxury group Richemont and U.S. truck‑and‑bus maker Workhorse Group (WKHS‑US) delayed earnings releases because of the outage. Critical services like police and hospitals were also affected, and insiders said the U.K.’s NHS had to reshuffle some medical procedures.

The first signs of the Microsoft outage appeared around 1 p.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, and Downdetector reports spiked quickly. Frustrated users flooded social platforms with complaints, many drawing parallels to previous large‑scale cloud outages.

Last year Amazon’s (AMZN‑US) web services (AWS) suffered a 15‑hour outage that impacted hundreds of sites. In 2024, cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike (CRWD‑US) caused global flight cancellations and system failures after a faulty software update, costing billions of dollars.

While the scope of this Microsoft incident was smaller than those events, it still had tangible effects on business operations. For example, apparel group PVH, which owns Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger, announced on Thursday it would cut about 4 % of its global workforce, but a planned layoff briefing in Asia on Friday morning was postponed because the outage prevented employees from receiving information about their positions.

The episode reignited concerns about corporate over‑reliance on a single tech supplier. Microsoft’s Windows OS and productivity tools remain essential infrastructure for many firms in the AI era, and Microsoft 365 now has over 450 million commercial users.

William Blair & Co. analyst Jason Ader wrote in a research note: “Given the high cost and complexity of replacing productivity tools that are deeply embedded in enterprise workflows, we do not expect this incident to materially affect Microsoft’s competitive position in the short term.”
He added: “In the long run, however, this could make some customers more open to alternatives, especially Google Workspace and the emerging productivity tools Anthropic announced earlier this week.”
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 前DeepMind與Anthropic班底 Mirendil募10億美元 Google參投 主攻AI代理自動化研發
items.title_en: Former DeepMind and Anthropic Team's Mirendil Raises $1 Billion, Backed by Google, to Focus on AI Agent Automation R&D
paras: AI新創Mirendil宣布完成10億美元A輪募資，由Kleiner Perkins與Clearlake Capital共同領投。這家成立僅一年的公司主打一個大膽主張：讓AI代理包辦模型研發的實作，一個研究員就能完成過去需要整個團隊的工作。
本輪參投方還包括Battery Ventures、Doerr Capital、Gil & Co、M13、Pear VC與S32等新舊投資人，以及Google（母公司為Alphabet，GOOGL-US）。公司未揭露本輪估值。
Mirendil於2025年成立，兩位創辦人的經歷涵蓋Google DeepMind與Anthropic。執行長Behnam Neyshabur是知名演算法SAM的共同發明人，該演算法能讓AI模型在未曾特別訓練的任務上表現更好；技術長Harsh Mehta曾負責預訓練專案。
公司首款產品Lor是一個把模型訓練工作分派給數百個AI代理執行的平台，目前處於封測階段。大型語言模型的開發涉及大量試錯：研究人員要做出多個只有細微差異的演算法版本再逐一比較，Mirendil稱Lor能自動化這個流程，評估過程中出錯時還會自動修正。
為了驗證這套方法，Mirendil今年稍早讓一名研究員在沒有同事協助的情況下，靠AI代理從零預訓練出編碼模型Mirendil-Base。公司表示，整個專案耗時約3.5個月、算力成本低於1,000萬美元，代理包辦了超過99%的程式碼，從架設基礎設施、尋找訓練演算法到蒐集與優化訓練資料一手完成；公司稱該模型可與領先的開源大型語言模型競爭。
Mirendil-Base隨後被後訓練成上月發布的編碼模型Fern，單次提示可處理1,000萬個輸入token，約相當於50萬行程式碼，公司稱為Claude Opus 5.5的十倍。Fern基於1,000億至5,000億參數的模型版本，公司10月底另預覽5,000億至10兆參數的升級版本，將用於開發更強的模型。
不過，上述效能與研發成果均為Mirendil自行公布，不能視為獨立驗證的結論。
Mirendil在公告中說，這輪資金將用於加速實現願景：讓前沿AI研發觸及每位科學家與工程師。本週稍早，AI代理管理新創LangChain也宣布完成3億美元C輪募資，估值30億美元。
paras_en: AI startup Mirendil announced the completion of a $1 billion Series A round, led jointly by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake Capital. The company, founded just a year ago, makes a bold claim: AI agents can handle the implementation of model development so that a single researcher can accomplish work that previously required an entire team.

The round also included participation from Battery Ventures, Doerr Capital, Gil & Co, M13, Pear VC and S32 among other existing and new investors, as well as Google (parent company Alphabet, GOOGL‑US). The company did not disclose the valuation for this round.

Mirendil was founded in 2025, and its two founders have backgrounds at Google DeepMind and Anthropic. CEO Behnam Neyshabur is a co‑inventor of the well‑known SAM algorithm, which enables AI models to perform better on tasks they have not been specifically trained for; CTO Harsh Mehta previously led pre‑training projects.

The company’s first product, Lor, is a platform that assigns model‑training work to hundreds of AI agents. It is currently in closed‑beta. Developing large language models involves massive trial‑and‑error: researchers must create many algorithm variants with only slight differences and compare them one by one. Mirendil says Lor automates this process and can automatically correct errors that arise during evaluation.

To validate the approach, Mirendil earlier this year had a researcher, working without any colleague assistance, use AI agents to pre‑train a coding model called Mirendil‑Base from scratch. The company said the entire project took about 3.5 months and cost less than $10 million in compute, with agents handling over 99 % of the code—from setting up infrastructure and selecting training algorithms to collecting and optimizing training data. The model is claimed to be competitive with leading open‑source large language models.

Mirendil‑Base was subsequently fine‑tuned into the coding model Fern released last month, which can process 10 million input tokens in a single prompt—roughly equivalent to 500 k lines of code, which the company says is ten times the capacity of Claude Opus 5.5. Fern is based on model versions ranging from 100 billion to 500 billion parameters; at the end of October the company previewed an upgraded version of 500 billion to 10 trillion parameters for developing even stronger models.
However, the performance figures and R&D results mentioned above are self‑reported by Mirendil and should not be taken as independently verified conclusions.

Mirendil said the new funding will be used to accelerate its vision of making cutting‑edge AI research accessible to every scientist and engineer. Earlier this week, AI‑agent management startup LangChain also announced a $300 million Series C round at a $3 billion valuation.

items.title: 特斯拉Cybercab開放個人訂購 售價3萬美元
items.title_en: Tesla Opens Personal Orders for Cybercab at $30,000
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 宣布向受邀客戶開放Cybercab訂購用於「個人用途」，售價約3萬美元，客戶需要支付1,000美元訂金，且必須訂閱每月299美元自動駕駛服務。
首批交付預定將於12月開始，但初期範圍僅限於美國德州5座城市以及指定區域。
特斯拉執行長馬斯克表示，隨著監管審批陸續通過，Cybercab將逐步向全美用戶開放。
不過，他也表示，每月299美元訂閱費用「太高了」，定價應與特斯拉其他車型上FSD及聯網服務費用相當，即每月約115美元。
馬斯克上周曾說，Cybercab未來還會實現一系列效率提升，使電池組容量能降至40kWh。特斯拉還會採用液態銀作為車身顏色，讓整體色彩不會過於單調。
馬斯克重申，Cybercab生產優先級高於Cybertruck。「如果我們必須維持Cybertruck複雜的產線和供應鏈，並為其持續投入工程技術人員，那麼這些人才、工廠和設備就無法用於擴大Cybercab產能。而Cybercab才是真正能夠徹底改變全球陸地交通運輸格局的車型。」
Cybercab作為特斯拉Robotaxi車隊未來主力，配備剪刀門（又稱蝴蝶門），車內沒方向盤、沒油門和剎車踏板，也沒後視鏡。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) announced that invited customers can now order the Cybercab for personal use at a price of about $30,000, with a $1,000 deposit required and a mandatory $299 per month autonomous driving subscription.
The first deliveries are slated to begin in December, initially limited to five cities in Texas and designated areas within the state.
CEO Elon Musk said that as regulatory approvals come through, the Cybercab will be gradually opened to users across the United States.

However, he also noted that the $299 monthly subscription fee is "too high" and should be priced similarly to Tesla's other models' Full Self‑Driving and connectivity services, roughly $115 per month.

Musk said last week that the Cybercab will eventually incorporate a series of efficiency improvements, reducing battery pack capacity to 40 kWh, and will use liquid silver as a body color to avoid a monotonous appearance.

Musk reiterated that Cybercab production takes priority over the Cybertruck, stating that if resources remain tied to the complex Cybertruck production line and its engineering staff, those people, factories, and equipment cannot be used to expand Cybercab capacity, and that Cybercab is the model that can truly transform global land transportation.

The Cybercab, envisioned as the future backbone of Tesla's robotaxi fleet, features scissor (butterfly) doors and an interior without a steering wheel, accelerator or brake pedals, and no rear‑view mirrors.

items.title: 美國問烏克蘭：願放棄頓巴斯換加入北約嗎？
items.title_en: U.S. Asks Ukraine: Will You Trade Donbas for NATO Membership?
paras: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基13日（周五）表示，在最近談判期間，美國代表詢問烏方是否願意從頓巴斯地區撤出軍隊，換取加入北約（NATO）。
據《基輔郵報》報導，澤倫斯基表示，美方在最近一輪外交會談中首次提出這個問題。
他指出，任何包含北約成員資格、具有約束力的安全保證和重建資金的具體方案，都會直接提交給烏克蘭公眾審議。烏方多次強調，不會撤退或放棄主權領土。
「如果美方與其他北約成員國一致向我國確認這一點，我會徵求社會意見：接受還是不接受？」他說，「我無權自行決定。」
澤倫斯基說道：「目前還需要具體細節，這些細節尚不明確，還都在討論中。」
他重申，烏方在任何情況下都不會在法律上承認俄佔烏東領土是俄羅斯的一部分。
paras_en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Friday the 13th that during recent negotiations, a U.S. representative asked whether Ukraine would be willing to withdraw its forces from the Donbas region in exchange for joining NATO.
According to the Kyiv Post, Zelensky said the United States raised this question for the first time in the latest round of diplomatic talks.

He noted that any concrete package that includes NATO membership, binding security guarantees and reconstruction funding would be submitted directly to the Ukrainian public for review. Kyiv has repeatedly stressed that it will not retreat from or relinquish its sovereign territory.
"If the United States and other NATO members confirm this to me collectively, I will seek public opinion: to accept or not?" he said, "I have no authority to decide on my own."
Zelensky added that specific details are still needed, and those details remain unclear and are still under discussion.
He reiterated that under no circumstances will Ukraine legally recognize the Russian‑occupied eastern Ukrainian territories as part of Russia.

items.title: 輝達醜聞使美商務部長盧特尼克面臨下台危機！《巴隆》恐牽動鋼鐵、加密貨幣與政府投資
paras: 美國商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick）因輝達(NVDA-US) 相關爭議遭到政府內外批評，傳出可能面臨去職危機。這場風波不僅牽涉美國對中國的晶片出口管制，也可能影響美國貿易政策、政府入股民間企業的布局，以及鋼鐵、加密貨幣與房貸金融等產業。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，爭議焦點在於，盧特尼克未將新加坡企業Megaspeed列入美國限制名單。該公司涉嫌協助將輝達先進晶片轉運至中國，藉此規避美國出口管制。
美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）週五（13日）接受《CNBC》訪問時，將矛頭指向商務部，批評該部門未將Megaspeed列入限制名單，導致該公司仍能取得美國技術。
盧特尼克預計將就此事赴參議院銀行委員會作證。預測市場Kalshi的交易者則估計，他今年卸任的機率達58%。
這起爭議也與輝達執行長黃仁勳本週辭職，以及他承認對妻子不忠的消息交織。此前有報導指出，黃仁勳曾與Megaspeed一名前高階主管黃樂（Alice Huang）發生婚外情，而美國正調查該名人士是否與中國情報機構有所關聯。

盧特尼克去留牽動鋼鐵、加密貨幣與房貸金融業

盧特尼克曾任金融服務公司Cantor Fitzgerald負責人，是川普在貿易談判、加密貨幣政策及華爾街相關議題上的重要幕僚，也主導美國政府擴大直接持有民間企業股權的政策。
Beacon Policy Advisors分析師Tedford指出，近幾個月盧特尼克介入美國與加拿大、墨西哥的貿易談判，力圖避免鋼鐵及鋁材關稅在更廣泛的貿易協議中遭到削弱。
這項立場有利於Cleveland-Cliffs與諾可(NUE-US) 等美國鋼鐵業者，兩家公司高層都曾將關稅視為支撐產業的重要因素。
在加密貨幣領域，盧特尼克同樣是產業支持者之一。去年，川普政府指派他等內閣官員研究如何增加政府持有的加密貨幣，配合川普提出的「戰略比特幣儲備」計畫；今年夏季國會審議有利加密貨幣產業的法案期間，他也曾與業者高層會面。
此外，盧特尼克與美國聯邦住房金融局（FHFA）局長普爾特（Bill Pulte）均支持出售房貸金融巨頭房利美（Fannie Mae）及房地美（Freddie Mac）部分股權。
報導指出，如果盧特尼克不再主掌商務部，上述三個產業的投資人可能面臨更高風險。

輝達風波恐讓美國政府入股企業政策加速

盧特尼克也是川普政府推動入股民間企業政策的主要設計者之一。不過，輝達風波未必會讓這項政策降溫，反而可能促使政府進一步擴大投資。
根據美國外交關係協會（CFR）資料，自2025年1月以來，美國政府已宣布49筆交易，涉及股權投資總額達308億美元，其中包括取得英特爾(INTC-US) 近10%股權。
Raymond James分析師Ed Mills指出，這些投資中有許多是為了降低美國對中國稀土及關鍵礦物供應的依賴。如果輝達醜聞促使川普對中國採取更強硬的立場，中國可能以限制稀土出貨作為反制，讓這類投資變得更加重要。
Mills表示，美中緊張局勢升高，「將加大美國建立自主供應鏈的壓力，也提高美國進一步加碼投資相關企業的可能性」。

items.title: GLP-1減重藥太貴保險難負擔 CVS：月費降至350美元才有機會打平
items.title_en: GLP-1 Weight‑Loss Drugs Too Expensive for Insurers; CVS Says Monthly Price Must Drop Below $350 to Break Even
paras: 2026年11月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ GLP-1減重藥有助改善患者健康，也可能減少後續住院及急診支出，但高昂藥價仍讓美國企業健康保險難以全面給付。美國醫療保健集團CVS Health(CVS-US)最新研究估算，若GLP-1藥物每月價格降至350美元以下，保險計畫因患者減少就醫而節省的醫療費用，才有機會抵銷新增藥費。
目前藥費距離這個門檻還有一段差距。美國員工福利研究所（EBRI）2025年估計，企業雇主及其他健康保險計畫支付的GLP-1藥物淨成本，約為每人每30天617至766美元，高於CVS估算的350美元。CVS並未透露旗下保險計畫實際支付的平均價格。
CVS追蹤約4,000名持續使用GLP-1藥物三年的患者，發現每人三年累計醫療費用比未用藥的相似患者少9,400美元，但處方藥支出卻多出13,300美元。兩者相抵後，保險計畫平均仍須多負擔3,900美元。
也就是說，保險計畫替患者支付藥費後，雖然可能因患者較少住院或急診而省下部分醫療費用，但節省金額仍不足以彌補藥費增加。CVS估算，若每月藥價降至350美元以下，節省的醫療費用才有機會抵銷藥費，讓企業擴大給付更符合成本效益。
CVS這項研究使用旗下Aetna健康保險的理賠資料，比較2023年至2025年間開始使用GLP-1藥物的患者，以及健康條件相近但未使用藥物的族群，最長追蹤三年。研究涵蓋肥胖、糖尿病及其他疾病患者，使用藥物包括禮來Eli Lilly(LLY-US)的Mounjaro、Zepbound，以及諾和諾德Novo Nordisk(NVO-US)的Ozempic、Wegovy。
藥費能否抵銷，也與患者原本的健康狀況有關。CVS首席醫療長Amy Compton-Phillips指出，住院風險較高的患者，若用藥後減少重大醫療事件，保險計畫可能較快看到費用節省效果；原本健康風險較低的患者，則可能需要更長時間，才能抵銷持續用藥的成本。
研究也發現，使用GLP-1藥物與較少的急診及住院次數有關。由於這是觀察性研究，尚無法直接證明醫療支出下降完全由藥物造成，且未單獨公布肥胖患者的結果。
CVS預計於11月15日在美國HLTH醫療產業大會發表研究結果。對美國企業雇主及健康保險業者而言，未來是否擴大GLP-1給付範圍，除了藥物療效，還須衡量藥價、患者健康風險及長期使用成本。

paras_en: November 14, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – GLP-1 weight‑loss drugs improve patient health and could reduce future hospital and emergency‑room costs, but their high price makes it difficult for U.S. corporate health insurers to cover them fully. CVS Health’s latest study estimates that only if the monthly price falls below $350 will the medical‑cost savings from fewer doctor visits offset the added drug expense.

The price is still far above that threshold. The Employee Benefit Research Institute (EBRI) projected that in 2025 corporate employers and other health plans will pay a net cost of $617‑$766 per person per 30 days for GLP‑1 drugs, well above CVS’s $350 estimate. CVS did not disclose the actual average price its plans pay.

CVS tracked about 4,000 patients who continuously used GLP‑1 drugs for three years and found that each person’s total medical costs over three years were $9,400 lower than similar patients who did not use the drugs, but prescription drug spending was $13,300 higher. After offsetting the two, insurers still had to shoulder an average extra $3,900 per member.

In other words, even after insurers pay for the medication, the savings from fewer hospitalizations or ER visits are not enough to cover the higher drug cost. CVS estimates that only if the monthly price drops below $350 will the saved medical expenses have a chance to offset the drug cost, making broader coverage more cost‑effective for companies.

The study used claims data from CVS’s Aetna health insurance, comparing patients who started GLP‑1 therapy between 2023 and 2025 with a matched cohort who did not use the drugs, with follow‑up up to three years. The analysis covered patients with obesity, diabetes and other conditions, using drugs such as Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro and Zepbound and Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic and Wegovy.

Whether drug costs can be offset also depends on patients’ baseline health. CVS chief medical officer Amy Compton‑Phillips said that high‑risk patients who avoid major medical events after treatment may show cost‑savings more quickly, whereas lower‑risk patients may take longer for the savings to outweigh the ongoing drug expense.

The research also found that GLP‑1 use was associated with fewer ER visits and hospital admissions. Because this is an observational study, it cannot prove that the reduction in medical spending is solely caused by the drugs, and results for obesity‑only patients were not reported separately.

CVS plans to present the findings at the HLTH conference in the United States on November 15. For corporate employers and health insurers, decisions about expanding GLP‑1 coverage will have to weigh not only efficacy but also price, patient health risk and long‑term cost.

items.title: Anthropic推Claude自託管代理！企業可將AI管理系統部署內部、降低雲端調度資安疑慮
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Managed Agents for Self‑Hosted Deployment, Enabling Enterprises to Run AI Management Systems Internally and Reduce Cloud Security Concerns
paras: Anthropic推出自託管版Claude託管代理（Claude Managed Agents），讓企業能將人工智慧（AI）代理的完整管理系統部署在自有私有雲或實體機房，不必再依賴Anthropic雲端伺服器調度任務。這項功能目前已開放私人測試，主要鎖定需要讓AI深入企業內部系統執行工作的用戶，協助解決核心程式碼與內部伺服器存取權限所帶來的資安疑慮。
隨著AI代理逐漸從對話工具轉向執行任務，應用範圍已延伸至程式碼修正、自動化部署與測試、監控警報分流，以及系統缺陷處理等工作。這類任務往往需要AI取得企業內部程式碼及伺服器的存取權限，也讓企業面臨新的安全與合規挑戰。
Anthropic過去提供的折衷方案，是讓企業在本地端執行虛擬沙箱，但代理的調度系統仍運作於Anthropic雲端。
新推出的自託管模式則進一步將調度伺服器、會話資料庫及執行沙箱都交由企業自行部署，使整套系統能在企業內部環境運作。

三層架構分工　任務調度、執行與資料儲存各自獨立

這套系統主要由三個部分組成。首先是調度伺服器，負責接收業務請求、維持代理的運作流程，以及分派各項任務，但不會直接執行程式碼或終端指令。
其次是執行沙箱與工人程序，負責接收調度伺服器下達的任務，並在獨立隔離環境中執行終端指令、讀取檔案及修改程式碼。每個沙箱都相當於獨立的工作環境，讓實際操作與任務調度分開。
第三部分則是資料庫。系統要求搭配企業自有的PostgreSQL資料庫，將代理設定、對話內容及歷史紀錄儲存在企業自己的硬碟中，即使調度伺服器重新啟動，也不會因此遺失過往的會話狀態。
至於哪些資料仍會離開企業內部網路，主要是在代理向大型語言模型（LLM）發出請求時，調度伺服器會將當下的對話脈絡及工具執行結果傳送至模型服務端。
企業也能依照自身合規需求選擇模型服務來源，包括Anthropic官方服務、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) AWS Bedrock、Google(GOOGL-US) Cloud、微軟(MSFT-US) Foundry，或自行架設的模型閘道。

三組密鑰分開管理　沙箱遭入侵也難以取得模型憑證

為避免權限集中造成風險，系統設計三種不同用途的密鑰。第一種是本地伺服器介面密鑰，供企業內部應用程式及管理工具使用，向自有調度伺服器下達指令。
第二種是模型呼叫憑證，僅保存在調度伺服器內部，用於連接遠端大型語言模型，執行沙箱中的工人程序無法取得這組憑證。
第三種是環境專屬密鑰，提供各個沙箱內的工人程序使用，讓它們能向本地調度伺服器取得所屬環境的任務。
透過這種權限分離設計，即使執行沙箱遭到入侵，攻擊者也無法直接取得調用大型語言模型所需的憑證。
不過，Anthropic也特別提醒，這套系統並不會自動替工人程序提供完整的安全防護。內建命令列工具具有實際系統權限，代理可以執行真正的終端指令，因此安全性完全取決於企業部署的沙箱環境。
Anthropic建議，企業應將工人程序放在一次性容器或虛擬機器中執行，任務完成後即予以銷毀。若直接在正式環境伺服器上執行，一旦代理發生誤操作，就可能對實際系統造成破壞。
這也代表，企業雖然能藉由自託管模式取得更高的系統控制權，但同時必須自行負責安全隔離、權限管理及資安稽核。
目前這套系統支援Linux及搭載蘋果(AAPL-US) 晶片的macOS環境。企業用戶可透過Anthropic業務團隊申請取得安裝套件與技術文件。
paras_en: Anthropic has introduced Claude Managed Agents, a self‑hosted version of its Claude AI agents, allowing enterprises to deploy the full AI‑agent management system on private clouds or on‑premises data centers instead of relying on Anthropic’s cloud servers for task scheduling. The feature is currently in private beta and targets users who need AI to operate deep within corporate systems, addressing security concerns around core code and internal server access.

As AI agents shift from conversational tools to task execution, their use cases now include code fixing, automated deployment and testing, alert routing, and system defect handling. These tasks often require the AI to access internal codebases and servers, presenting new security and compliance challenges for companies.
Anthropic’s previous compromise was to let enterprises run a virtual sandbox locally while the agent scheduling system still operated in Anthropic’s cloud.

The new self‑hosted mode pushes the scheduling server, conversation database, and execution sandbox all onto the enterprise’s own infrastructure, allowing the entire system to run inside the corporate environment.

The architecture is split into three layers—task scheduling, execution, and data storage—each operating independently. The scheduling server receives business requests, maintains the agent workflow, and dispatches tasks, but it does not execute code or terminal commands directly.

The execution layer consists of sandboxes and worker processes that receive tasks from the scheduler and run terminal commands, read files, and modify code within isolated environments. Each sandbox functions as a separate work environment, keeping actual execution separate from scheduling.

The third component is the database. The system requires the enterprise’s own PostgreSQL instance to store agent configurations, conversation content, and history on the company’s disks, ensuring that a scheduler restart does not lose prior session state.

Data that leaves the corporate network is limited to the context and tool results sent to the large language model (LLM) when the agent makes a request; the scheduling server forwards this information to the model service endpoint.

Enterprises can choose the model service source to meet compliance needs, including Anthropic’s own service, Amazon (AMZN‑US) AWS Bedrock, Google (GOOGL‑US) Cloud, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) Foundry, or a self‑hosted model gateway.
Three separate keys are managed to avoid centralized risk. The first is a local server interface key used by internal applications and management tools to issue commands to the on‑premises scheduler.
The second is a model‑call credential stored only inside the scheduler for connecting to remote LLMs; worker processes in the sandbox cannot access this credential.
The third is an environment‑specific key provided to each sandbox’s worker processes so they can retrieve tasks from the local scheduler for their own environment.
With this permission‑separation design, even if a sandbox is compromised, attackers cannot obtain the credentials needed to invoke the LLM.

Anthropic cautions that the system does not automatically provide full security for worker processes. Built‑in command‑line tools have real system privileges, and agents can execute genuine terminal commands, so security depends entirely on the sandbox environment the enterprise deploys.

Anthropic recommends running worker processes in disposable containers or virtual machines that are destroyed after task completion. Executing agents directly on production servers risks real‑world damage if the agent misbehaves.
Thus, while self‑hosting gives enterprises greater control, they must also assume responsibility for isolation, permission management, and security auditing.

The system currently supports Linux and macOS environments powered by Apple (AAPL‑US) silicon. Enterprise customers can request installation packages and technical documentation through Anthropic’s sales team.

items.title: 輝瑞、信達GLP-1新藥納中國醫保糖尿病用藥市場競爭升溫
items.title_en: Pfizer and Innovent GLP-1 New Drugs Enter China’s Medicare Diabetes Market, Heightening Competition
paras: 2026年11月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國GLP-1糖尿病用藥市場再添醫保競爭者。中國國家醫保局公布，輝瑞Pfizer(PFE-US)的ecnoglutide與信達生物的mazdutide將自2027年1月1日起納入國家醫保，給付對象為第二型糖尿病患者，對諾和諾德形成新的競爭壓力。
納入醫保有助降低患者負擔、擴大藥物使用量，但藥廠通常也須以較低價格換取更大的市場。本次公布消息未揭露兩款藥物的醫保談判價格。
中國GLP-1醫保市場已有多家藥廠布局。諾和諾德的Ozempic於2022年納入給付，禮來Eli Lilly(LLY-US)的Mounjaro及Guangzhou Innogen Pharmaceutical的efsubaglutide alfa則自2026年起納入第二型糖尿病給付。隨著輝瑞與信達加入，藥廠競爭將進一步延伸至醫保通路。
諾和諾德在大中華區的Ozempic銷售已面臨壓力。涵蓋中國、台灣及香港的區域銷售額，2025年下滑7%，約54億丹麥克朗。新藥取得醫保資格後，市場關注焦點將是用藥量增加能否支撐銷售，以及競爭加劇對價格的影響。

paras_en: November 14, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – China’s GLP‑1 diabetes drug market gains another Medicare competitor. The National Healthcare Security Administration announced that Pfizer’s (PFE‑US) ecnoglutide and Innovent Biologics’ mazdutide will be covered by national Medicare starting January 1, 2027, with reimbursement for type‑2 diabetes patients, creating new competitive pressure for Novo Nordisk.

Inclusion in Medicare helps lower patients’ financial burden and expands drug usage, but manufacturers usually have to accept lower prices in exchange for a larger market. The announcement did not disclose the negotiated Medicare prices for the two drugs.

China’s GLP‑1 Medicare market already hosts several players. Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic was added to reimbursement in 2022, Eli Lilly’s (LLY‑US) Mounjaro and Guangzhou Innogen Pharmaceutical’s efsubaglutide alfa were slated for type‑2 diabetes coverage starting in 2026. With Pfizer and Innovent joining, competition among manufacturers will further extend into the Medicare channel.

Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic sales in Greater China have already felt pressure. Regional sales covering China, Taiwan and Hong Kong fell 7% in 2025 to about 5.4 billion Danish crowns. After the new drugs obtain Medicare status, market focus will be on whether the increase in usage can sustain sales and how intensified competition will affect pricing.

items.title: 黃仁勳卸任前專訪曝！《彭博》紀錄片談AI安全、對中晶片與輝達接班布局
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Pre‑Resignation Interview Revealed! Bloomberg Documentary Discusses AI Safety, China Chip Exports, and Nvidia Succession Plans
paras: 《彭博》旗下Bloomberg Originals於11月12日推出最新紀錄片《The Rise and Reckoning of Jensen Huang》，由《The Circuit》主持人Emily Chang專訪輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳，記錄他對人工智慧（AI）產業發展、主權AI、對中國晶片出口、AI安全及公司接班布局的看法。
這部長達45分鐘的紀錄片於10月拍攝，Chang隨行走訪巴黎、倫敦、斯德哥爾摩及柏林，並在美國波特蘭的GTC大會繼續採訪。
當時黃仁勳仍是全球AI浪潮中最具影響力的企業領袖之一；然而，影片上線之際，輝達董事會已因相關報導啟動獨立調查，黃仁勳的離去也成為市場焦點，讓片中談及公司治理、接班與產業風險的內容再度受到關注。

從AI五層架構到主權AI　黃仁勳談全球布局

紀錄片中，黃仁勳將AI產業比喻為一個由五層組成的蛋糕，從底部往上依序為能源、晶片、基礎設施、模型及應用。輝達最初專注於第二層的晶片，如今則已向產業上下游擴大投資，布局AI生態系的不同環節。
他也在歐洲行程中積極推廣「主權AI」（Sovereign AI），主張各國應掌握自身資料、文化價值與機構知識，並有權決定自己的發展方向。
面對主持人質疑，若AI基礎設施仰賴美國晶片，是否仍能稱為主權AI，黃仁勳表示，主權的核心在於掌握自身的使用體驗，包括資料、企業運作、國家文化價值及人民的機構知識。
談及美中科技競爭，黃仁勳坦言，輝達如今已無法進入中國市場。他表示，自己一直努力向美國政策制定者說明參與中國市場的重要性，認為美國在這方面犯了錯誤，而且很難扭轉。
他也強調，中國並非美國的敵人。若各國真正關切AI安全，就應該展開對話，並在可能的範圍內合作。

AI安全與資本支出爭議　黃仁勳反駁產業風險疑慮

隨著AI代理（AI Agents）逐漸普及，AI系統的安全性與可控性也成為訪談重點。黃仁勳認為，提升AI能力與安全並不衝突，兩者必須同步推進。
他以AI模型產生幻覺為例指出，業界透過檢索增強生成（RAG）、擴大上下文窗口，以及讓模型連接工具等技術，改善模型回答的可靠性。
對於部分業者警告AI模型可能出現異常行為，甚至逃避關閉，黃仁勳主張，自主系統與具身系統必須受到嚴格限制及監控；如果無法確保這些條件，就不應進行測試或部署。但他不認同因此停止相關研究，認為應該設法控制並監督實驗。
紀錄片也觸及輝達在AI產業鏈中的投資及資本支出。黃仁勳表示，AI技術需要龐大資本投入，新一代AI新創企業往往需要數十億美元資金，而非僅靠1,000萬美元就能取得足夠支持。
他指出，輝達過去5年投入約1,000億美元，並帶動其他機構投資人投入至少相當於五倍的資金，進一步擴大AI生態系。
對於外界質疑輝達向AI企業投資、同時又向其銷售晶片，可能形成循環融資，黃仁勳並未在訪談中逐一回應個別交易，而是強調AI產業需要高額資本支出。他也不認為客戶對輝達的依賴構成系統性風險，表示客戶是自主選擇輝達，而公司必須每天重新贏得客戶支持。

談女兒接班傳聞　希望下一任執行長來自公司內部

談到個人管理風格，黃仁勳表示，他希望打造盡可能沒有官僚體系的組織，認為目前的管理方式有助於公司持續成長與創新。
對於外界傳聞女兒可能接任執行長，他表示不會強迫子女接班，因為這必須是他們自己的志向，也必須靠自身努力爭取。他坦言，自己當初決定擔任執行長時，並未充分理解這份職位所承受的壓力與責任。
黃仁勳表示，希望輝達下一任執行長已經在公司內部，並期待公司能持續培養下一代領導人才。他也強調，接班人必須靠自己的能力取得職位，就如同他自己也可能被解雇一樣。
不過，紀錄片上線前後，黃仁勳的個人處境出現重大變化。根據相關媒體報導，輝達董事會11月8日宣布啟動由獨立董事主導、外部律師協助的調查，並表示目前沒有理由認為相關事件危及國家安全或造成公司機密外洩，同時表達對黃仁勳及管理團隊的信任。
此後，《華爾街日報》報導董事會正準備解除黃仁勳的執行長職務，消息一度引發市場震盪。美國國會議員也要求黃仁勳就相關問題作出說明。
輝達週四（12日）宣布，黃仁勳辭任執行長並退出董事會，由財務長 Colette Kress 暫代執行長。
黃仁勳1993年共同創立輝達，現年63歲，持有公司約3.6%股份。輝達董事會共有11名成員，除黃仁勳外，其餘均為獨立董事。紀錄片中，他曾表示希望自己能在20年後仍保持健康，但更重要的是，公司必須持續培養能夠接班的領導人才。
paras_en: Bloomberg Originals released the documentary "The Rise and Reckoning of Jensen Huang" on November 12, featuring host Emily Chang interviewing Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang about the development of the AI industry, sovereign AI, China chip exports, AI safety, and the company’s succession strategy.
The 45‑minute film was shot in October, with Chang traveling to Paris, London, Stockholm, and Berlin, and continuing the interview at the GTC conference in Portland, USA.

At the time, Huang was still one of the most influential leaders in the global AI wave; however, by the time the film premiered, Nvidia’s board had launched an independent investigation in response to related reports, and Huang’s departure became a market focus, drawing renewed attention to the film’s discussion of corporate governance, succession, and industry risk.

In the documentary, Huang likened the AI industry to a five‑layer cake, from bottom to top: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, and applications. Nvidia initially focused on the second layer—chips—but has now expanded investments across the entire AI ecosystem.

During his European tour, he actively promoted the concept of "sovereign AI," arguing that each country should control its own data, cultural values, institutional knowledge, and have the right to determine its own development path.

When questioned by the host about whether AI infrastructure relying on U.S. chips could still be considered sovereign AI, Huang said that sovereignty centers on controlling the user experience, including data, business operations, national cultural values, and the people’s institutional knowledge.

On the U.S.–China tech rivalry, Huang admitted that Nvidia can no longer enter the Chinese market. He said he has always tried to explain to U.S. policymakers the importance of participating in China, that the U.S. has made a mistake in this area, and that it is difficult to reverse.
He also emphasized that China is not an enemy of the U.S. If countries truly care about AI safety, they should engage in dialogue and cooperate where possible.

With AI agents becoming more common, the safety and controllability of AI systems became a focus of the interview. Huang believes that improving AI capability and safety are not mutually exclusive and must progress together.
He cited hallucinations in AI models and explained that the industry uses retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), larger context windows, and tool‑connected models to improve answer reliability.

Regarding some vendors warning that AI models might behave abnormally or evade shutdown, Huang argued that autonomous and embodied systems must be strictly restricted and monitored; if those conditions cannot be ensured, testing or deployment should not proceed. He does not agree with halting research, believing that experiments should be controlled and supervised.

The documentary also touched on Nvidia’s investments and capital expenditures in the AI supply chain. Huang said that AI technology requires massive capital, and new AI startups often need billions of dollars, not just a hundred million, to get sufficient support.
He noted that Nvidia has invested about $100 billion over the past five years and has driven other investors to contribute at least five times that amount, further expanding the AI ecosystem.

When questioned about Nvidia’s potential circular financing by investing in AI companies while also selling chips to them, Huang did not address each transaction individually but emphasized the high capital requirements of the AI industry. He also does not see customer dependence on Nvidia as a systemic risk, stating that customers choose Nvidia independently and the company must win their support every day.

On personal management style, Huang said he wants to build an organization with as little bureaucracy as possible, believing that the current management approach helps the company continue to grow and innovate.

Regarding rumors that his daughter might succeed him as CEO, he said he would not force a child to take over, as it must be their own ambition and effort. He admitted that when he first became CEO, he did not fully understand the pressure and responsibility of the role.

Huang expressed that he hopes the next Nvidia CEO will already be inside the company and that the company should continue to nurture future leaders. He also stressed that the successor must earn the position through their own abilities, just as he could be fired.

However, after the documentary’s release, Huang’s personal situation changed dramatically. According to reports, Nvidia’s board announced on November 8 that it had launched an investigation led by independent directors with external lawyers, stating that there was no reason to believe the events threatened national security or caused a breach of company secrets, and expressed trust in Huang and the management team.

Subsequently, the Wall Street Journal reported that the board was preparing to remove Huang from the CEO position, a story that caused market turbulence. U.S. congressional members also demanded that Huang explain the related issues.
On Thursday (12th), Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang had resigned as CEO and left the board, with CFO Colette Kress acting as interim CEO.

Huang co‑founded Nvidia in 1993, is 63 years old, and holds about 3.6% of the company. The board has 11 members, all independent except for Huang. In the documentary, he said he hopes to remain healthy in 20 years, but more importantly, the company must continue to develop leaders capable of succession.

items.title: 歐盟擬限縮SpaceX星鏈頻譜資源！30兆赫僅開放10兆赫競標、馬斯克反彈
items.title_en: EU Plans to Restrict SpaceX Starlink Spectrum Resources! Only 10 MHz of 30 MHz Open for Bidding, Musk Pushes Back
paras: 歐盟正醞釀重新分配移動衛星服務頻譜，計畫將大部分資源保留給歐洲政府及本土業者，星鏈（Starlink）等國際業者只能競標部分頻寬。這項方案不僅引發SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克反彈，也讓美國對歐盟強化通訊自主的布局表達不滿，歐美之間的太空競爭可能因此升溫。
根據西班牙《世界報》報導，歐盟現行移動衛星服務頻段許可將於2027年5月到期，屆時相關頻譜將重新招標。不過，歐盟執委會提出的規劃，打算將總計30兆赫（MHz）的頻譜劃分為三部分：10兆赫供政府用途、10兆赫保留給一家歐洲業者提供商業服務，剩餘10兆赫則開放全球業者競標。
按照這項方案，星鏈只能競逐其中10兆赫。考量星鏈未來20年業務預期將大幅成長，能取得的頻譜資源卻遠少於目前，對此，馬斯克表示無法接受。
美國也對歐盟的規劃提出警告。美國駐歐盟大使普茲德（Andrew Puzder）幾周前表示，若布魯塞爾持續推動這項計畫，將帶來「毀滅性的後果」。不過，歐盟內部仍審慎看待推動方案的可能性，希望藉此提升自身在關鍵通訊領域的自主能力。
布魯蓋爾研究所（Bruegel）高級研究員 Guntram Wolff 指出，歐洲各國普遍憂心對美國依賴過深，降低這種依賴已成為各方迫切訴求，而重新分配頻譜正是其中一種途徑。

頻譜分配牽動歐洲自主通訊布局

報導稱，歐盟此舉的核心並非單純爭奪商業收益，而是希望降低在關鍵通訊基礎設施上對美國業者的依賴。規劃中保留給政府用途的10兆赫，主要是為歐洲衛星彈性、互聯性和安全性基礎設施計畫（Iris2）衛星星座預留。
Iris2由348顆衛星組成，目標是建立可與星鏈相抗衡的安全通訊系統。西班牙衛星公司是該計畫主要承建商之一，負責地面系統及超低軌道衛星星座，在相關頻譜服務中扮演重要角色。
西班牙衛星公司執行長 Luis Mayo 表示，歐盟可能進一步推動政府用途與歐洲商業服務用途的兩部分頻譜協同運作，以提高使用效率。這也意味著得標業者之間可能需要整合系統，或以共同營運的方式提供服務。
目前已有業者簽署協議，計畫組成歐洲業者聯盟共同競標，但該聯盟並無意自行建置衛星星座，而是打算將相關業務外包給第三方。此外，也有規模較小的企業表達參與意願，包括西班牙衛星物聯網公司。
該公司執行長 Carlos Riopedre 強調，歐洲本土業者的定義必須明確，不能只是在布魯塞爾設立辦公室、完成行政程序，就自稱是歐洲企業；真正的決策權必須留在歐洲，且不受第三國管轄。

歐盟方案仍待各方協商　美國影響力成變數

不過，這項規劃距離定案仍有一段距離。歐洲議會必須先形成自身立場，歐盟成員國也須取得共識。其中，成員國協商可能面臨更大阻力，因為頻譜許可過去一向由各國自行招標，相關收入歸各國政府，管理權也掌握在成員國手中；歐盟如今則希望透過立法改革，將部分權限收歸歐盟層級。
外界也關注美國可能施加的政治壓力，促使部分與現任美國政府關係較密切的歐盟成員國改變立場。英國同樣密切觀察事態發展。英國相關許可到期時間與歐盟相近，但已決定延長現有許可，待進一步了解歐盟方案的運作方式後再作考量。
面對衛星通訊市場擴張，電信業者的策略也逐漸分歧。一部分選擇與馬斯克合作，另一部分則採取防範措施，避免星鏈接觸自家客戶，以限制其市場擴張。
此外，SpaceX仍握有一項重要籌碼：歐洲衛星發射服務。目前歐洲新一代衛星星座面臨的主要瓶頸之一，就是發射能力。若發射管道受阻，歐洲相關計畫的成本將大幅增加，而歐洲目前尚無足以與SpaceX抗衡的衛星發射力量。
paras_en: The EU is preparing to reallocate spectrum for mobile satellite services, planning to keep most of the resources for European governments and domestic operators, while international players such as Starlink will only be able to bid for a portion of the bandwidth. The proposal has sparked a backlash from SpaceX (SPCX‑US) CEO Elon Musk and drawn criticism from the United States, which is displeased with the EU’s move to strengthen its own communications autonomy, potentially heating up the space rivalry between Europe and the U.S.

According to Spain’s El Mundo, the EU’s current licence for mobile satellite service bands expires in May 2027, after which the spectrum will be re‑tendered. The European Commission’s plan is to split the total 30 MHz of spectrum into three blocks: 10 MHz for government use, 10 MHz reserved for a single European operator to provide commercial services, and the remaining 10 MHz opened to global operators for bidding.

Under this scheme, Starlink would be limited to competing for only the 10 MHz block. Musk says he cannot accept a situation where, despite expecting a massive growth in its business over the next 20 years, Starlink would receive far less spectrum than it currently enjoys.

The United States also warned against the EU’s plan. U.S. Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder said a few weeks ago that if Brussels pushes ahead, it could have “devastating consequences.” Nevertheless, EU officials remain cautious about the likelihood of moving forward, hoping the measure will boost Europe’s autonomy in critical communications.

Bruegel senior fellow Guntram Wolff noted that many European countries are worried about over‑reliance on the United States, and reducing that dependence has become an urgent demand, with spectrum reallocation seen as one avenue to achieve it.

The report says the EU’s move is not simply about commercial profit but about reducing reliance on U.S. players for critical communications infrastructure. The 10 MHz set aside for government use is intended for the Iris 2 satellite constellation, a European satellite‑flexibility, interconnectivity and security infrastructure project.

Iris 2 will consist of 348 satellites and aims to create a secure communications system that can rival Starlink. A Spanish satellite company is one of the main contractors for the project, handling ground systems and the low‑Earth‑orbit satellite constellation and playing a key role in the related spectrum services.

Luis Mayo, CEO of the Spanish satellite firm, said the EU may further promote coordinated use of the two spectrum portions – government and European commercial – to improve efficiency. This could mean that winning bidders might need to integrate their systems or operate jointly to provide services.

Some operators have already signed agreements to form a European consortium that will bid together, but the consortium does not intend to build its own satellite constellation; instead it plans to outsource the relevant activities to a third party. Smaller companies, including a Spanish satellite IoT firm, have also expressed interest in participating.

Carlos Riopedre, CEO of that company, stressed that the definition of a European domestic operator must be clear – merely setting up an office in Brussels and completing administrative steps does not make a firm European; real decision‑making power must stay in Europe and not be subject to third‑country jurisdiction.

The EU proposal is still subject to negotiation, with U.S. influence a variable factor. The European Parliament must first adopt its position, and EU member states need to reach consensus. Negotiations may face strong resistance because spectrum licences have traditionally been awarded by individual countries, with revenues and management staying at the national level; the EU now seeks to shift part of that authority to the EU level through legislative reform.

Observers are also watching for possible political pressure from the United States that could sway EU members with close ties to the current U.S. administration. The United Kingdom is closely monitoring the situation as well. The UK’s licences expire around the same time as the EU’s, but it has decided to extend its existing licences while it studies how the EU scheme will operate before making further decisions.

As the satellite communications market expands, telecom operators’ strategies are diverging. Some are choosing to cooperate with Musk, while others are taking defensive measures to keep Starlink away from their customers in order to limit its market expansion.

SpaceX still holds a crucial bargaining chip: European satellite launch services. One of the main bottlenecks for Europe’s next‑generation satellite constellations is launch capacity. If launch pathways are blocked, the cost of European projects will rise sharply, and Europe currently lacks a launch capability that can compete with SpaceX.

items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Posts Biggest Weekly Gain Since September as Fed Rate Hikes Near Certain
paras: 美元周五(13日)再創19個月新高，並寫下9月中旬以來最強單週表現。這波漲勢主要受到市場對美國聯準會(Fed)升息預期大幅升高所帶動。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報103.41，創2025年4月2日以來新高。本週已上漲1.1%。
美元這波漲勢始於上週五美國就業報告公布後。美國10月非農就業人數增加16.5萬人，遠高於市場預期的6.5萬人。此外，8月與9月的就業人數合計上修8.4萬人。
美元週一短暫喘息後，週二再度走高，主要因美國消費者物價指數(CPI)數據高於預期。10月整體CPI月增0.4%，低於9月的0.6%，但仍高於市場預期的0.3%。排除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心CPI月增率維持在0.3%，略高於市場預期的0.2%。
數據顯示，美國勞動市場表現強勁，通膨也持續居高不下。在此情況下，央行通常會採取緊縮貨幣政策。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)週二進一步釋出鷹派訊號，表示即使通膨數據低於預期，他仍支持升息，他並指出，若數據再度偏熱，政策利率甚至可能需要一次調升50個基點，高於一般升息幅度。
週五公布的最新生產者物價指數(PPI)報告，則稍稍緩解市場疑慮。10月整體PPI月增0.3%，明顯低於9月的1.4%，也低於市場預期的0.4%。年增率則為6.5%，略低於預期的6.6%。不過，這仍是2022年11月以來最大的12個月漲幅。
Fifth Third Wealth Advisors投資長Chris Osmond表示，「好消息是，生產者物價通膨已從9月高點降溫。壞消息是，降幅可能還不足以讓市場獲得期待中的利率緩解。生產者物價通膨年增率仍高達6.5%，今天公布的報告提高了限制性利率維持更長時間的風險，恐怕超出投資人原先預期。」
他補充，「或許比整體數字更重要的是，通膨壓力正從能源擴散到其他領域。10月能源價格實際下跌，但食品價格上漲1.3%，服務業價格連續第五個月上漲，運輸與倉儲成本也增加2.0%。這顯示通膨正逐漸滲透至整體經濟，而非僅集中在最初出現價格壓力的領域。若這種情況持續，Fed就更難將通膨視為暫時現象。」
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，交易員幾乎篤定Fed將在12月升息，問題在於升息幅度。市場預期升息25個基點的機率接近90%，升息幅度高達50個基點的機率則約為10%。
日元再度貶破160關卡
美元走強對日元造成壓力，日元兌美元匯率本週創下9月中旬以來最差單週表現。日元最新報159.76兌1美元，稍早盤中一度觸及160.19的低點。
這是日元連續第二個交易日貶破160關卡。週四日元才首次自9月2日以來跌破此水準。過去，160關卡曾多次觸發東京當局大規模干預匯市。
日本財務省週一表示，7月至9月期間，日本在外匯市場干預操作中共動用15.4兆日元（約963.8億美元），其中包括7月30日單日創紀錄的7.98兆日元，以及7月31日與華府採取史無前例聯合行動時投入的5.55兆日元。這是美日自1998年以來首次聯手買進日元。
日本財務省負責外匯事務的最高官員三村淳(Atsushi Mimura)警告市場應提防「單邊走勢」，並提醒交易員，「現在就忘記」美日聯合干預還言之過早。
美元走強也使歐元承壓。歐元兌美元下跌0.3%，至1.1022美元，本週創下10月初以來最差單週表現。

paras_en: The dollar hit a 19‑month high on Friday (the 13th) and recorded its strongest weekly performance since mid‑September. This rally was driven mainly by a sharp rise in market expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 103.41, a peak not seen since April 2, 2025. It is up 1.1% for the week.

The dollar’s advance began after Friday’s U.S. jobs report. Non‑farm payrolls for October increased by 165,000, far above the 65,000 forecast, and the August‑September combined payroll figure was revised up by 84,000.

After a brief pause on Monday, the dollar moved higher again on Tuesday, largely because U.S. consumer price index (CPI) data came in hotter than expected. October’s overall CPI rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, down from September’s 0.6% but still above the 0.3% market estimate. Core CPI, which strips out volatile food and energy prices, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, slightly above the 0.2% forecast.

The data show a still‑robust labor market and persistently high inflation, conditions that typically prompt central banks to tighten policy. Fed Governor Christopher Waller signaled further hawkishness on Tuesday, saying that even if inflation data miss expectations he still backs a rate hike and noted that a repeat of hot data could warrant a 50‑basis‑point move, larger than the usual increment.

The latest producer price index (PPI) released on Friday eased some concerns. October’s overall PPI rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, well below September’s 1.4% and the 0.4% market forecast. The year‑over‑year rate was 6.5%, just under the 6.6% expected, but it remains the biggest 12‑month gain since November 2022.

Chris Osmond, Chief Investment Officer at Fifth Third Wealth Advisors, said, “The good news is that producer‑price inflation has cooled from its September peak. The bad news is that the decline may not be enough for the market to see the rate‑cut relief it hopes for. Producer‑price inflation is still at a 6.5% annual pace, and today’s report raises the risk that restrictive rates will have to stay in place longer than investors originally expected.”

He added, “Perhaps more important than the headline number is that inflation pressure is spreading from energy to other areas. Energy prices fell in October, but food rose 1.3%, services posted a fifth consecutive month of price gains, and transportation and warehousing costs rose 2.0%. This shows inflation is seeping into the broader economy rather than staying confined to the initial price‑pressure zones. If this continues, it will be harder for the Fed to treat inflation as a temporary phenomenon.”

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders are almost certain the Fed will raise rates in December, with the question being the size of the hike. The market assigns roughly a 90% probability to a 25‑basis‑point increase and about a 10% chance of a 50‑basis‑point move.
The yen slipped past the 160 per dollar barrier again.

A stronger dollar put pressure on the yen, which posted its worst weekly performance since mid‑September. The yen was last quoted at 159.76 per dollar, after briefly touching a low of 160.19 earlier in the session.

This marks the second consecutive trading day the yen fell below the 160 level. It first breached that threshold on Thursday, the first time since September 2. Historically, the 160 barrier has often triggered large‑scale intervention by Tokyo authorities.

Japan’s Ministry of Finance said on Monday that between July and September it intervened in the foreign‑exchange market for a total of ¥15.4 trillion (about $96.38 billion), including a record ¥7.98 trillion on July 30 and ¥5.55 trillion on July 31 when it coordinated an unprecedented joint action with Washington. This is the first time since 1998 that the U.S. and Japan have jointly bought yen.

Atsushi Mimura, the senior official in charge of foreign‑exchange affairs at the Ministry, warned the market to beware of “unilateral moves” and told traders that it was “still too early to say the joint U.S.–Japan intervention is over.”
A stronger dollar also weighed on the euro. The euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1022, marking its weakest weekly performance since early October.

Preliminary official estimates released earlier showed Euro‑area GDP grew 0.4% quarter‑on‑quarter in Q3 2026, down from 0.6% in Q2 but in line with expectations. The data also revised labor‑market conditions, indicating that employment growth stalled in the third quarter.

items.title: 日元逼近160關卡！日本匯率主管再警告市場勿忘夏季干預 暗示可能單獨出手
items.title_en: Yen Nearing the 160 Barrier! Japan's Exchange Rate Chief Warns Market Not to Forget Summer Intervention, Hints at Possible Solo Action
paras: 日元兌美元匯率再度逼近160這個日本當局曾出手干預的重要關卡之際，日本最高外匯事務官員三村淳(Atsushi Mimura)周四(12日)警告市場參與者，「現在還不是忘記今年夏季干預行動的時候」，顯示日本當局已準備好再次出手干預，以支撐日元。
日本財務省主管匯率事務的最高官員三村淳說：「我強烈感覺到，過去幾天的匯率波動速度太快了。」他並表示：「現在還不是忘記今年夏天發生什麼事的時候。」不過，他沒有針對特定匯率水準發表評論。
這是三村淳自9月底以來首度針對外匯市場發表談話，而他所指的是日本7月底至8月初買進日元的干預行動，包括與美國聯手進場的操作。
三村淳發出警告之際，日元兌美元匯率周四盤中一度升至159.94，創逾兩個月來新高。日元先前貶破160關卡之後，日本當局7月曾連續三天進場支撐日元，其中一部分還是與美國協調進行的。夏季那波為期三天的干預行動協助日元兌美元匯率從貶破163，回升至最高155.23。
在聯手干預行動後，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與日本財務大臣片山皋月曾警告，當局已準備好再次採取行動，以因應匯市波動。

日元走弱推升進口成本 日本通膨壓力升高

日元疲軟一直是日本決策官員面臨的棘手問題，這導致進口成本大幅攀升。周四公布的數據顯示，以日元計價的進口物價指數10月年增24.8%。
美國通膨數據偏熱，加上聯準會(Fed)官員發表鷹派談話，讓市場愈來愈預期美國將升息，帶動美元走強。而在市場預期美日利差將進一步擴大的情況下，日元再度蒙受壓力。
日本方面，市場已大致消化日本銀行(BOJ，央行)將在12月18日至19日會議升息的預期。但後續升息時程仍不明朗，因為市場預期日本政策利率將逐步接近中性利率水準。
瑞穗證券分析師說：「美國經濟展現韌性，加上人工智慧(AI)投資強勁帶動通膨持續處於高檔，美元兌日元匯率可能繼續走高。」
報告指出：「如果美元突破160關卡，且日元進一步走弱推升通膨，增加首相高市早苗政府支持度下滑的風險，東京當局可能採取單方面干預行動。」
paras_en: The yen‑dollar exchange rate is once again approaching the critical 160 level where Japanese authorities have previously intervened, and Japan's top foreign exchange official Atsushi Mimura warned market participants on Thursday (the 12th) that "now is not the time to forget this summer's intervention action," indicating that the authorities are ready to step in again to support the yen.

Atsushi Mimura, the senior official in charge of exchange rate matters at the Ministry of Finance, said, "I strongly feel that the speed of exchange‑rate fluctuations over the past few days has been too rapid," adding, "Now is not the time to forget what happened this summer." He did not comment on any specific exchange‑rate level.

This is Mimura's first public comment on the foreign‑exchange market since the end of September, referring to Japan's July‑late to early‑August intervention that bought yen, including coordinated actions with the United States.

When Mimura issued his warning, the yen‑dollar rate rose intraday on Thursday to 159.94, a two‑month high. After the yen slipped past the 160 barrier, Japanese authorities intervened for three consecutive days in July, part of which was coordinated with the U.S.; that three‑day summer intervention helped lift the yen from a dip below 163 back up to a peak of 155.23.

Following the joint intervention, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki warned that the authorities were prepared to act again in response to market volatility.

A weak yen has been a persistent headache for Japanese policymakers, driving up import costs. Data released on Thursday showed the import price index, measured in yen, rose 24.8% year‑on‑year in October.

U.S. inflation data remains hot and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials have heightened expectations of further U.S. rate hikes, strengthening the dollar. With markets expecting the Japan‑U.S. interest‑rate gap to widen, the yen faces renewed pressure.

In Japan, markets have largely priced in expectations that the Bank of Japan will raise rates at its meeting on December 18‑19, but the timing of any further hikes remains unclear as markets anticipate the policy rate moving gradually toward a neutral level.
Mizuho Securities analysts said, "The U.S. economy is showing resilience, and strong AI‑driven investment is keeping inflation elevated, so the dollar‑yen pair may continue to rise."

The report noted, "If the dollar breaks the 160 barrier and the yen weakens further, pushing up inflation and increasing the risk of declining support for Prime Minister Kishida's government, Tokyo may resort to unilateral intervention."

paras: 美國通膨持續升溫，加上聯準會（Fed）官員接連釋出鷹派訊號，市場升息預期急速升溫，ICE 美元指數周三（11 日）一度升至 102.96，創下 19 個月新高。
隨著交易員開始押注聯準會 12 月可能一口氣升息 2 碼，短期美債殖利率飆升，全球主要貨幣普遍承壓，美元漲勢成為市場關注焦點。
隨著交易員開始將聯準會 12 月升息 2 碼納入定價，美債殖利率走揚、全球主要貨幣承壓，美元成為金融市場關注焦點。
行情數據顯示，衡量美元兌一籃子主要貨幣表現的 ICE 美元指數(DXY) ，周三盤中最高觸及 102.96，創下 2025 年 4 月以來最高水準。
另一項廣受市場關注的彭博美元指數，也創下今年 6 月以來最大兩日漲幅，盤中觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最高水準。美元當天兌幾乎所有主要貨幣均走強，顯示買盤持續湧入。
美元本波漲勢在周二明顯加速，主要受到美國通膨數據與聯準會官員鷹派言論雙重推動。
最新數據顯示，美國 10 月消費者物價漲幅連續第三個月高於市場預期，促使交易員重新評估聯準會未來升息幅度，甚至開始將 12 月一次升息 50 個基點（2 碼）的可能性納入定價。
隨著短期美債殖利率飆升，美國與其他主要經濟體之間的利差擴大，進一步吸引追求較高報酬的資金流向美元資產。
12月升息1碼機率達88% 華爾街上修預測
加拿大帝國商業銀行（CIBC）策略師 Jeremy Stretch 表示，美元近期走強，核心原因在於市場持續重新調整對聯準會貨幣政策路徑的預期。
他指出，無論是聯準會一次升息 50 個基點，或加快目前每季升息一次的緊縮步伐，如今都已成為市場實際討論的政策選項。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，周三貨幣市場預估，聯準會 12 月升息 25 個基點的機率達 88%，升息 50 個基點的機率則為 12%。
在周二通膨數據公布後，華爾街主要券商也陸續調整利率預測。
高盛目前預估，聯準會將分別在今年 12 月及明年 3 月升息；德意志銀行則預期，聯準會將在今年 12 月、明年 1 月及 3 月連續升息，顯示市場對貨幣政策進一步緊縮的預期正在升高。
美元還能漲多高？市場緊盯PPI數據
不過，在 12 月升息逐漸成為市場基本預期後，美元能否進一步突破高點，仍取決於後續經濟數據與聯準會政策訊號。
DHF Capital 資產經理 Bas Kooijman 表示，若美元要延續漲勢，市場可能需要進一步提高對聯準會升息 50 個基點的押注。
他指出，若周五公布的美國生產者物價指數（PPI）再度高於預期，或聯準會官員持續釋出鷹派訊號，可能進一步推升美債殖利率，帶動美元突破近期高點。
反之，若經濟數據轉弱，或投資人對大幅升息的預期降溫，美元可能回吐部分漲幅。
值得注意的是，美國公債市場周三因退伍軍人節假期休市。
歐元跌破1.11 法國債務問題再添壓力
美元強勢走高，也持續對其他主要貨幣形成壓力。
今年以來，除了澳元與挪威克朗之外，多數 G10 已開發市場貨幣兌美元均呈現貶值，反映美國與其他經濟體之間不斷擴大的利差。
部分分析師也認為，今年美元的強勢表現，部分來自美國與以色列對伊朗戰爭期間湧入的避險資金。
其中，歐元承受的壓力尤其明顯。
歐元兌美元隔夜下跌 0.65%，跌破 1.11 美元關卡，延續前一交易日跌勢，並觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最低水準。

她表示，另一項可能在未來數月壓抑歐元的因素，是明年法國總統大選帶來的政治不確定性。若極右派候選人當選總統，可能對歐盟未來合作方向產生影響。
荷蘭合作銀行預估，歐元兌美元將在未來三個月內進一步跌至 1.10。
隨著聯準會升息預期持續升溫，市場接下來將密切關注美國通膨數據與官員談話，判斷美元是否仍有進一步走強的空間。
paras_en: U.S. inflation continues to heat up, and Fed officials have been issuing hawkish signals, causing rate‑hike expectations to surge. The ICE Dollar Index rose to 102.96 on Wednesday (the 11th), hitting a 19‑month high.

As traders began betting that the Fed could raise rates by two full points in December, short‑term U.S. Treasury yields spiked, major currencies worldwide came under pressure, and the dollar’s rally became the market’s focal point.
With traders pricing in a two‑point Fed hike in December, Treasury yields climbed, major currencies were pressured, and the dollar took center stage in financial markets.
Market data show that the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the dollar against a basket of major currencies, reached a intraday high of 102.96 on Wednesday, the highest level since April 2025.

The Bloomberg Dollar Index, also closely watched by the market, posted its biggest two‑day gain since June this year, touching its highest level since May 2025. The dollar strengthened against almost all major currencies, indicating continued buying pressure.
The dollar’s current rally accelerated noticeably on Tuesday, driven by a combination of U.S. inflation data and hawkish comments from Fed officials.

The latest data show that October’s U.S. consumer price inflation rose above expectations for the third consecutive month, prompting traders to reassess the Fed’s future rate‑hike magnitude and even start pricing in a possible 50‑basis‑point (two‑point) hike in December.

As short‑term Treasury yields surged, the interest‑rate gap between the United States and other major economies widened, further attracting funds seeking higher returns into dollar‑denominated assets.
Probability of a one‑point December hike reaches 88% – Wall Street revises forecasts.
CIBC strategist Jeremy Stretch said the dollar’s recent strength is mainly due to the market’s ongoing recalibration of expectations for the Fed’s monetary‑policy path.
He noted that whether the Fed raises rates by 50 basis points in one move or accelerates its current quarterly‑rate‑hike cadence, both options are now being seriously discussed in the market.

According to London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) data, Wednesday’s currency‑market estimates put the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December at 88%, while a 50‑basis‑point hike was seen at 12%.
After Tuesday’s inflation data release, major Wall Street brokerages began adjusting their rate forecasts.

Goldman Sachs now expects the Fed to raise rates in both December this year and March next year; Deutsche Bank forecasts three consecutive hikes in December, January and March, indicating rising market expectations for further monetary tightening.
How much higher can the dollar go? Markets keep a close eye on PPI data.
However, once a December hike becomes the market’s baseline expectation, whether the dollar can push beyond its recent peak will depend on upcoming economic data and Fed policy signals.
DHF Capital asset manager Bas Kooijman said that for the dollar to keep climbing, the market may need to increase its bets on a 50‑basis‑point Fed hike.

He added that if Friday’s U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) comes in above expectations, or if Fed officials continue to issue hawkish remarks, Treasury yields could rise further, propelling the dollar past its recent high.
Conversely, weaker economic data or a cooling of expectations for large rate hikes could cause the dollar to give back some of its gains.
It is worth noting that the U.S. Treasury market was closed on Wednesday for the Veterans Day holiday.
Euro slips below 1.11 as French debt woes add pressure.
The strong dollar continues to weigh on other major currencies.

Since the start of the year, most G10 developed‑market currencies have depreciated against the dollar, except for the Australian dollar and the Norwegian krone, reflecting the widening interest‑rate differentials between the U.S. and other economies.
Some analysts also attribute this year’s dollar strength partly to safe‑haven flows that surged during the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran.
The euro, in particular, feels the pressure.
The euro fell 0.65% against the dollar overnight, breaking the 1.11‑dollar barrier and extending the decline from the previous session, reaching its lowest level since May 2025.
In addition to the strong dollar, France’s debt problems continue to drag the euro down, and falling oil prices have cooled market expectations for European Central Bank rate hikes.
Rabobank FX strategist Jane Foley said the ECB’s last press conference revealed growing concerns among the Governing Council about the economic‑growth outlook.

She added that another factor that could suppress the euro in the coming months is the political uncertainty surrounding next year’s French presidential election; a far‑right victory could affect the EU’s future cooperation direction.
Rabobank projects the euro will fall further to around 1.10 against the dollar within the next three months.
As expectations for Fed rate hikes keep rising, markets will closely watch U.S. inflation data and Fed officials’ remarks to gauge whether the dollar still has room to strengthen further.

Brown Brothers Harriman全球市場策略主管Elias Haddad表示，升息預期升高有助於支撐美元。
Haddad表示：「美元普遍走強，主要受到Fed利率預期轉趨鷹派支撐。這項轉變由高於預期的10月CPI數據推動，近期Fed官員的談話也進一步放大了這股趨勢。」
包括Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)及達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)在內的官員都表示，對通膨居高不下感到不安，華勒甚至不排除大幅升息2碼(50個基點)的可能性，進一步推升市場升息押注。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.50%，報1.33美元，接近兩周來最低點。美元兌瑞士法郎則上漲0.93%，報0.833瑞郎，盤中一度升至10月中旬以來最高水準。

高盛與德銀調整預測 今年多數主要貨幣走貶

周二的通膨數據公布後，部分券商調整對Fed未來貨幣政策的預測。高盛目前預期，Fed將在12月及明年3月升息，德意志銀行則預期，升息時間點將落在12月、明年1月及3月。
除了澳幣與挪威克朗外，多數已開發市場貨幣兌美元今年來均走貶，原因是利差擴大推升美元。部分分析師也將美元今年走強歸因於美國與以色列對伊朗開戰期間，市場資金流向避險資產。
